title.zh: 卷一百〇六 志第五十九 禮九
title.raw: 卷一百〇六 志第五十九 禮九 Volume 106 Treatises 59: Rites 9

sentences.zh: 宗廟之制

translations.literal: The regulations on ancestral temples
translations.idiomatic: Regulations on Ancestral Temples

sentences.zh: 建隆元年，有司請立宗廟，詔下其議。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jianlong, the responsible officials requested to establish ancestral temples, and an edict was issued to circulate their proposal for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: In 960, the responsible ministries petitioned to establish the imperial ancestral temples, and the court ordered the proposal submitted for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書張昭等奏：「謹案堯、舜、禹皆立五廟，蓋二昭二穆與其 始祖也。

translations.literal: Minister of War Zhang Zhao and others memorialized: "We respectfully note that Yao, Shun, and Yu each established five temples, comprising two Zhao, two Mu, and their founding ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Zhang Zhao and others memorialized: "We respectfully note that Yao, Shun, and Yu each maintained five ancestral temples—two Zhao, two Mu, and the founding ancestor.

sentences.zh: 有商建國，改立六廟，蓋昭穆之外，祀契與湯也。

translations.literal: When Shang established the state, it was changed to six temples, beyond the Zhao and Mu, venerating Qi and Tang.
translations.idiomatic: When the Shang founded their state, they expanded the system to six temples, adding Qi and Tang beyond the Zhao and Mu shrines.

sentences.zh: 周立七廟，蓋親廟之外，祀太祖與文王、武王也。

translations.literal: Zhou established seven temples, beyond the close ancestral temples, venerating the Great Ancestor together with King Wen and King Wu.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhou then established seven temples, adding the Great Ancestor, King Wen, and King Wu beyond the close ancestral shrines.

sentences.zh: 漢初立廟，悉不如禮。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Han, temples were established, all not in accord with ritual.
translations.idiomatic: When the Han first established their temples, none of the arrangements conformed to proper ritual.

sentences.zh: 魏、晉始復七廟之制，江左相承 不改。

translations.literal: Wei and Jin first restored the system of seven temples, and the region south of the Yangzi inherited it without change.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei and Jin dynasties first restored the seven-temple system, which the states south of the Yangzi then inherited without alteration.

sentences.zh: 然七廟之室，隋文但立高、曾、祖、禰四廟而已。

translations.literal: Yet among the chambers of the seven temples, Emperor Wen of Sui only established four temples—for the great-great-grandfather, great-grandfather, grandfather, and father.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in practice, Emperor Wen of Sui built only four temple chambers—for the great-great-grandfather, great-grandfather, grandfather, and father.

sentences.zh: 唐因立親廟，梁氏而下，不易其法。

translations.literal: Tang followed by establishing close ancestral temples; from the House of Liang downward, they did not alter this method.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang followed suit by establishing close ancestral temples, and from the Liang dynasty onward successive regimes kept this practice unchanged.

sentences.zh: 稽古之道，斯為折衷。

translations.literal: Examining the ways of antiquity, this is a balanced compromise.
translations.idiomatic: Measured against ancient precedent, this represents a balanced compromise.

sentences.zh: 伏請追尊高、曾四代，崇建廟室。

translations.literal: We humbly request posthumously honoring four generations of great-great-grandfather and great-grandfather rank, and loftily constructing temple chambers.
translations.idiomatic: We humbly request that four generations of great-great-grandfather and great-grandfather rank be posthumously honored and that corresponding temple chambers be erected.

sentences.zh: 」於是判太常 寺竇儼奏上皇高祖文安府君曰文獻皇帝，廟號僖祖；

translations.literal: " Thereupon the acting director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, Dou Yan, memorialized that the emperor's great-great-grandfather, Lord of Wen'an, should be titled Emperor Wenxian, with the temple name Ancestor Xi;
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon Dou Yan, acting director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, memorialized that the emperor's great-great-grandfather, Lord of Wen'an, should receive the posthumous title Emperor Wenxian, with the temple name Ancestor Xi;

sentences.zh: 皇曾祖中丞府君曰惠元皇帝，廟號順祖；

translations.literal: the emperor's great-grandfather, Lord Censor-in-Chief, should be titled Emperor Huiyuan, with the temple name Ancestor Shun;
translations.idiomatic: that the emperor's great-grandfather, Lord Censor-in-Chief, should receive the title Emperor Huiyuan, with the temple name Ancestor Shun;

sentences.zh: 皇祖驍衛府君曰簡恭皇帝，廟號翼祖；

translations.literal: the emperor's grandfather, Lord of the Valiant Guard, should be titled Emperor Jiangong, with the temple name Ancestor Yi;
translations.idiomatic: that the emperor's grandfather, Lord of the Valiant Guard, should receive the title Emperor Jiangong, with the temple name Ancestor Yi;

sentences.zh: 皇考武清府君曰昭武皇帝，廟號 宣祖；

translations.literal: the emperor's father, Lord of Wuqing, should be titled Emperor Zhaowu, with the temple name Ancestor Xuan;
translations.idiomatic: and that the emperor's father, Lord of Wuqing, should receive the title Emperor Zhaowu, with the temple name Ancestor Xuan;

sentences.zh: 皇高祖妣崔氏曰文懿皇后；

translations.literal: the emperor's great-great-grandmother, Lady Cui, should be titled Empress Wanyi;
translations.idiomatic: that the emperor's great-great-grandmother, Lady Cui, should receive the title Empress Wanyi;

sentences.zh: 皇曾祖妣桑氏曰惠明皇后；

translations.literal: the emperor's great-grandmother, Lady Sang, should be titled Empress Huiming;
translations.idiomatic: that the emperor's great-grandmother, Lady Sang, should receive the title Empress Huiming;

sentences.zh: 皇祖妣京兆郡太夫人劉氏曰簡穆皇后。

translations.literal: and the emperor's grandmother, Grand Lady of Jingzhao Commandery, Lady Liu, should be titled Empress Jianmu.
translations.idiomatic: and that the emperor's grandmother, Grand Lady of Jingzhao Commandery, Lady Liu, should receive the title Empress Jianmu.

sentences.zh: 太祖禦崇元殿，備禮冊四親廟，奉安神主，行上諡之禮。

translations.literal: The Taizu emperor took the throne in the Hall of Exalted Origin, completed the rites of enfeoffment for the four close ancestral temples, installed the spirit tablets, and performed the ceremony of bestowing posthumous titles.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizu held court in the Hall of Exalted Origin, completed the enfeoffment rites for the four close ancestral temples, installed the spirit tablets, and performed the ceremony of bestowing posthumous titles.

sentences.zh: 二年十 月，祔明憲皇后杜氏於宣祖室。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the second year, Empress Mingxian, Lady Du, was enshrined collaterally in the chamber of Ancestor Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the second year, Empress Mingxian, née Du, was enshrined collaterally in the chamber of Ancestor Xuan.

sentences.zh: 太平興國二年，有司言：「唐制，長安太廟，凡九廟，同殿異室。

translations.literal: In the second year of Taiping Xingguo, the responsible officials stated: "Under the Tang system, the Grand Temple at Chang'an comprised nine temples in all, sharing one hall but with separate chambers.
translations.idiomatic: In 977, the responsible ministries reported: "Under the Tang system, the Grand Temple at Chang'an comprised nine shrines in all, housed in one hall but with separate chambers.

sentences.zh: 其制：二十一間皆四柱，東西夾室各一，前後麵各三 階，東西各二側階。

translations.literal: Its design: twenty-one bays, all with four pillars; one collateral chamber on the east and west each; three steps on the front and rear faces each; two side steps on the east and west each.
translations.idiomatic: Its design called for twenty-one bays, each with four pillars; one collateral chamber on either side; three steps on the front and rear façades; and two side staircases on the east and west.

sentences.zh: 本朝太廟四室，室三間。

translations.literal: Our dynasty's Grand Temple has four chambers, each chamber of three bays.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty's Grand Temple has four chambers, each of three bays.

sentences.zh: 今太祖升祔，共成五室，請依長安之制，東西留夾室外，餘十間分為五室，室二間。

translations.literal: Now that Taizu has been elevated and enshrined collaterally, there are five chambers in all. We request following the Chang'an system: leaving the collateral chambers on the east and west, divide the remaining ten bays into five chambers of two bays each.
translations.idiomatic: Now that Taizu has been elevated and enshrined collaterally, there are five chambers in all. We request that, following the Chang'an model, the collateral chambers on the east and west be retained and the remaining ten bays be divided into five chambers of two bays each.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The court approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 四月己卯，奉神主祔廟， 以孝明皇后王氏配。

translations.literal: On the day jimao of the fourth month, the spirit tablets were brought and enshrined collaterally in the temple, with Empress Xiaoming, Lady Wang, as consort.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, the fourth month, the spirit tablets were installed in the temple, with Empress Xiaoming, née Wang, enshrined as consort.

sentences.zh: 至道三年十一月甲子，奉太宗神主祔廟，以懿德皇后符氏配。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, day jiazi, of the third year of Zhidao, the spirit tablet of Taizong was brought and enshrined collaterally in the temple, with Empress Yide, Lady Fu, as consort.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of 997, on the day jiazi, Taizong's spirit tablet was installed in the temple, with Empress Yide, née Fu, enshrined as consort.

sentences.zh: 咸平元年，判太常禮院李宗訥等言：「僖祖稱曾高祖，太祖稱伯；

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianping, Li Zong'e and others of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices stated: "Ancestor Xi is addressed as great-great-grandfather and great-grandfather; Taizu is addressed as elder uncle;
translations.idiomatic: In 998, Li Zong'e and others of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: "Ancestor Xi is addressed as great-great-grandfather and great-grandfather, while Taizu is addressed as elder uncle;

sentences.zh: 文 懿、惠明、簡穆、昭憲皇后並稱祖妣，孝明、孝惠、孝章皇后並稱伯妣。

translations.literal: Empresses Wenyi, Huiming, Jianmu, and Zhaoxian are all addressed as ancestral grandmothers; Empresses Xiaoming, Xiaohui, and Xiaozhang are all addressed as elder uncles' wives.
translations.idiomatic: Empresses Wenyi, Huiming, Jianmu, and Zhaoxian are all addressed as ancestral grandmothers, while Empresses Xiaoming, Xiaohui, and Xiaozhang are all addressed as elder uncles' wives.

sentences.zh: 按《爾雅》有考妣、王父母、曾祖王父母、高祖王父母及世父之別。

translations.literal: According to the Erya, there are distinctions among father and mother, paternal grandparents, great-grandparents, great-great-grandparents, and father's elder brother.
translations.idiomatic: The Erya distinguishes among terms for father and mother, paternal grandparents, great-grandparents, great-great-grandparents, and the father's elder brother.

sentences.zh: 以此觀之，唯父母得稱 考妣。

translations.literal: Viewed in this light, only parents may be addressed as father and mother.
translations.idiomatic: On this basis, only one's own parents may properly be addressed as "father" and "mother."

sentences.zh: 今請僖祖止稱廟號，順祖而下，即依《爾雅》之文。

translations.literal: We now request that Ancestor Xi be addressed only by his temple name, and from Ancestor Shun downward, that the text of the Erya be followed.
translations.idiomatic: We now request that Ancestor Xi be addressed only by his temple name, and that from Ancestor Shun downward the terminology of the Erya be followed.

sentences.zh: 」事下尚書省議，戶部尚書張齊賢等言：「《王制》『天子七廟』。

translations.literal: " The matter was referred to the Department of State Affairs for deliberation. Minister of Revenue Zhang Qixian and others stated: "The Royal Regulations states, 'The Son of Heaven has seven temples.'
translations.idiomatic: " The matter was referred to the Department of State Affairs for deliberation. Minister of Revenue Zhang Qixian and others argued: "The Royal Regulations states that 'the Son of Heaven maintains seven temples.'

sentences.zh: 謂三昭三穆與太祖之廟而七。

translations.literal: This means three Zhao, three Mu, and the temple of the Great Ancestor, making seven.
translations.idiomatic: This means three Zhao, three Mu, and the temple of the Great Ancestor—seven in all.

sentences.zh: 前代或 有兄弟繼及，亦移昭穆之列，是以《漢書》『為人後者為之子』，所以尊本祖而重正統也。

translations.literal: In former ages there were sometimes cases of succession by a younger brother, and the Zhao and Mu ranks were also shifted accordingly; hence the Han shu, 'One who becomes another's heir is considered his son'—this is to honor one's original ancestor and uphold legitimate succession.
translations.idiomatic: In earlier dynasties, when a younger brother succeeded the throne, the Zhao and Mu ranks were rearranged accordingly; hence the Han shu's dictum that 'one who becomes another's heir is considered his son'—a rule meant to honor one's original ancestor and uphold legitimate succession.

sentences.zh: 又《禮》云：『天子絕期喪。

translations.literal: Moreover, the Rites states: 'The Son of Heaven discontinues mourning at the end of the first year.'
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the Rites states that 'the Son of Heaven discontinues mourning at the end of the first year.'

sentences.zh: 』安得宗廟中有伯氏之稱乎？

translations.literal: ' How then can there be an address of elder uncle in the ancestral temple?
translations.idiomatic: ' How then can the ancestral temple include an address of 'elder uncle'?

sentences.zh: 其唐及五代有 所稱者，蓋禮官之失，非正典也。

translations.literal: Where Tang and the Five Dynasties used such addresses, this was surely an error of the ritual officials, not the correct canon.
translations.idiomatic: Where the Tang and Five Dynasties used such addresses, this was surely an error on the part of ritual officials, not authoritative precedent.

sentences.zh: 請自今有事於太廟，則太祖並諸祖室，稱孝孫、孝曾孫嗣皇帝；

translations.literal: We request that from now on, when rites are performed at the Grand Temple, in the chambers of Taizu and the various ancestors the emperor be styled Filial Grandson and Filial Great-Grandson, the succeeding emperor;
translations.idiomatic: We request that henceforth, when rites are performed at the Grand Temple, in the chambers of Taizu and the earlier ancestors the emperor be styled 'Filial Grandson' and 'Filial Great-Grandson, the succeeding emperor';

sentences.zh: 太宗室，稱孝子嗣皇帝。

translations.literal: in the chamber of Taizong, he be styled Filial Son, the succeeding emperor.
translations.idiomatic: and in Taizong's chamber, 'Filial Son, the succeeding emperor.'

sentences.zh: 其《爾雅》『考妣』、『王父』之文，本 不為宗廟言也。

translations.literal: The Erya's passages on 'father and mother' and 'paternal grandfather' were originally not intended for use in the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: The Erya's passages on 'father and mother' and 'paternal grandfather' were never intended for use in the ancestral temple in the first place.

sentences.zh: 歷代既無所取，於今亦不可行。」

translations.literal: Former dynasties took nothing from them; they cannot be implemented today either."
translations.idiomatic: Earlier dynasties drew nothing from them, and they cannot be implemented today either."

sentences.zh: 詔下禮官議。

translations.literal: An edict was issued ordering the ritual officials to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered the ritual officials to deliberate further.

sentences.zh: 議曰：「按《春秋正義》『躋魯僖公』云：『禮，父子異昭穆，兄弟昭、穆同。

translations.literal: The deliberation stated: "According to the Correct Meaning of the Spring and Autumn Annals on 'Elevating Duke Xi of Lu,' it says: 'In ritual, father and son occupy different Zhao and Mu positions; brothers share the same Zhao or Mu position.'
translations.idiomatic: Their deliberation stated: "According to the Correct Meaning of the Spring and Autumn Annals on 'Elevating Duke Xi of Lu,' ritual dictates that father and son occupy different Zhao and Mu positions, while brothers share the same Zhao or Mu position.

sentences.zh: 』此明 兄弟繼統，同為一代。

translations.literal: ' This shows clearly that when brothers succeed one another in rule, they belong to the same generation.
translations.idiomatic: ' This shows clearly that when brothers succeed one another on the throne, they belong to the same generation.

sentences.zh: 又魯隱、桓繼及，皆當穆位。

translations.literal: Moreover, when Duke Yin and Duke Huan of Lu succeeded one another, both occupied the Mu position.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, when Duke Yin and Duke Huan of Lu succeeded one another, both occupied the Mu position.

sentences.zh: 又《尚書》盤庚有商及王，《史記》雲陽甲至小乙兄弟四人相承，故不稱嗣子而曰及王，明不繼兄之統也。

translations.literal: Moreover, in the Documents, Pan Geng speaks of kings succeeding in Shang; the Shiji states that from Yang Jia to Xiao Yi four brothers succeeded one another in rule, and therefore they were not called succeeding sons but kings succeeding—showing clearly that they did not inherit a brother's succession.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, in the Documents Pan Geng speaks of kings succeeding in Shang, and the Shiji records that from Yang Jia to Xiao Yi four brothers succeeded one another on the throne; they were therefore styled 'succeeding kings' rather than 'succeeding sons,' showing that they did not inherit a brother's line of succession.

sentences.zh: 又唐 中、睿皆處昭位，敬、文、武昭穆同為一世。

translations.literal: Moreover, in Tang, Zhongzong and Ruizong both occupied Zhao positions; Jingzong, Wenzong, and Wuzong shared the same Zhao and Mu as one generation.
translations.idiomatic: In Tang times as well, Zhongzong and Ruizong both occupied Zhao positions, while Jingzong, Wenzong, and Wuzong shared the same Zhao and Mu as a single generation.

sentences.zh: 伏請僖祖室止稱廟號，後曰祖妣，順祖室曰高祖，後曰高祖妣，翼祖室曰曾祖，後曰曾祖妣，祝文皆稱孝曾孫。

translations.literal: We humbly request that in the chamber of Ancestor Xi only the temple name be used, the consort addressed as ancestral grandmother; in the chamber of Ancestor Shun, 'great-great-grandfather,' the consort as 'great-great-grandmother'; in the chamber of Ancestor Yi, 'great-grandfather,' the consort as 'great-grandmother'; in all prayer texts, 'Filial Great-Grandson.'
translations.idiomatic: We humbly request that in Ancestor Xi's chamber only the temple name be used and the consort addressed as 'ancestral grandmother'; in Ancestor Shun's chamber, 'great-great-grandfather,' with the consort as 'great-great-grandmother'; in Ancestor Yi's chamber, 'great-grandfather,' with the consort as 'great-grandmother'; and that all prayer texts use 'Filial Great-Grandson.'

sentences.zh: 宣祖室 曰皇祖考，後曰皇祖妣，祝文稱孝孫。

translations.literal: In the chamber of Ancestor Xuan, 'imperial grandfather,' the consort as 'imperial grandmother'; prayer texts styled 'Filial Grandson.'
translations.idiomatic: In Ancestor Xuan's chamber, the address should be 'imperial grandfather,' the consort 'imperial grandmother,' and prayer texts 'Filial Grandson.'

sentences.zh: 太祖室曰皇伯考妣，太宗室曰皇考妣。

translations.literal: In the chamber of Taizu, 'imperial elder uncle and aunt'; in the chamber of Taizong, 'imperial father and mother.'
translations.idiomatic: In Taizu's chamber, 'imperial elder uncle and aunt'; in Taizong's chamber, 'imperial father and mother.'

sentences.zh: 每大祭，太祖、太宗昭、穆同位，祝文並稱孝子。

translations.literal: At each great sacrifice, Taizu and Taizong share the same Zhao and Mu position; prayer texts uniformly style 'Filial Son.'
translations.idiomatic: At each great sacrifice, Taizu and Taizong share the same Zhao and Mu position, and prayer texts uniformly use 'Filial Son.'

sentences.zh: 其別廟稱謂，亦請依此。」

translations.literal: The designations for the separate temples should also follow this."
translations.idiomatic: The designations for the separate temples should follow the same rule."

sentences.zh: 詔都省復集議，曰：「古者，祖有功，宗有德，皆先有其實而後正其名。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Imperial Secretariat to reconvene for deliberation, stating: "In antiquity, 'zu' honored merit and 'zong' honored virtue; both first had the reality and only afterward received the correct name.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered the Imperial Secretariat to reconvene, arguing: "In antiquity, a zu honored merit and a zong honored virtue—both were first established in fact and only afterward received their proper titles.

sentences.zh: 今太祖受命開基，太宗纘承大寶，則百世不祧之廟矣。

translations.literal: Now Taizu received the Mandate and founded the dynasty; Taizong continued and inherited the great treasure—thus they are temples never to be displaced for a hundred generations.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu received the Mandate and founded the dynasty; Taizong continued the enterprise and inherited the throne—they are therefore temples never to be displaced for a hundred generations.

sentences.zh: 豈有祖宗之廟已分二世，昭穆之位 翻為一代？

translations.literal: How can it be that the temples of the ancestors have already been divided into two generations, yet the Zhao and Mu positions are reversed to become one generation?
translations.idiomatic: How can the ancestral temples already be divided into two generations, yet the Zhao and Mu positions be collapsed into one?

sentences.zh: 如臣等議，禮『為人後者為之子』，以正父子之道，以定昭、穆之義，則無疑也。

translations.literal: As in our deliberation, the ritual dictum 'one who becomes another's heir is considered his son' rectifies the way of father and son and fixes the meaning of Zhao and Mu—then there is no doubt.
translations.idiomatic: As we argue, the ritual dictum that 'one who becomes another's heir is considered his son' rectifies the relationship between father and son and fixes the meaning of Zhao and Mu—leaving no room for doubt.

sentences.zh: 必若同為一代，則太宗不得自為世數，而何以得為宗乎？

translations.literal: If they must be treated as one generation, then Taizong cannot count as his own generation—how then can he be made a zong?
translations.idiomatic: If they must be treated as one generation, Taizong cannot count as his own generation—how then can he be made a zong?

sentences.zh: 不得為宗，又 何以得為百世不祧之主乎？

translations.literal: If he cannot be made a zong, how then can he be the lord never displaced for a hundred generations?
translations.idiomatic: If he cannot be made a zong, how can he be the lord whose temple is never displaced for a hundred generations?

sentences.zh: 《春秋正義》亦不言昭。

translations.literal: The Correct Meaning of the Spring and Autumn Annals also does not state that Zhao
translations.idiomatic: The Correct Meaning of the Spring and Autumn Annals also does not state that Zhao

sentences.zh: 穆不可異，此又不可以為證也。

translations.literal: and Mu cannot differ—this too cannot serve as evidence.
translations.idiomatic: and Mu cannot differ—this too cannot serve as evidence.

sentences.zh: 今若序為六世，以一昭一穆言之，則上無毀廟之嫌，下有善繼之美，於禮為大 順，於時為合宜，何嫌而謂不可乎？

translations.literal: If we now arrange them as six generations, speaking in terms of one Zhao and one Mu, then above there is no suspicion of destroying temples, and below there is the beauty of good succession; in ritual this is greatly compliant, and for the times it is fitting—what objection can there be in saying it cannot be done?
translations.idiomatic: If we now arrange them as six generations, with one Zhao and one Mu, then above there is no risk of destroying temples and below there is the merit of orderly succession; in ritual terms this is greatly compliant and for the present age entirely fitting—what objection can there be to saying it cannot be done?

sentences.zh: 」翰林學士宋湜言：「三代而下，兄弟相繼則多，昭、穆異位，未之見也。

translations.literal: " Hanlin Academician Song Mi stated: "From the Three Dynasties downward, succession by brothers has been frequent, but Zhao and Mu in different positions—this has not been seen.
translations.idiomatic: " Hanlin Academician Song Mi objected: "From the Three Dynasties onward, brotherly succession has been common, but Zhao and Mu occupying different positions for such cases—this has never been seen.

sentences.zh: 今詳都省所議，皇帝於太祖室稱孫，竊有疑焉。」

translations.literal: Now examining closely the Imperial Secretariat's deliberation, that the emperor in Taizu's chamber should be styled grandson—I privately have doubts about this."
translations.idiomatic: Examining the Imperial Secretariat's proposal closely, I have private doubts about styling the emperor as 'grandson' in Taizu's chamber."

sentences.zh: 詔令禮官再議。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the ritual officials to deliberate again.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered the ritual officials to deliberate once more.

sentences.zh: 禮官言：「按《祭統》曰：『祭有昭、穆者，所以別父子遠近長幼親疏之序而無亂也。

translations.literal: The ritual officials stated: "According to the Treatise on Sacrificial Rites: 'Sacrifices have Zhao and Mu in order to distinguish the sequence of father and son, near and far, elder and younger, close and distant, without disorder.'
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officials replied: "According to the Treatise on Sacrificial Rites, 'sacrifices employ Zhao and Mu to distinguish the sequence of father and son, near and far, elder and younger, close and distant, without disorder.'

sentences.zh: 』《公羊傳》，公孫嬰齊為兄歸父之後，《春秋》謂之仲嬰 齊。

translations.literal: ' In the Gongyang Commentary, Gongsun Yingqi became the heir of his elder brother Gui Fu; the Spring and Autumn Annals calls him Zhong Yingqi.
translations.idiomatic: ' The Gongyang Commentary records that Gongsun Yingqi became the heir of his elder brother Gui Fu; the Spring and Autumn Annals calls him Zhong Yingqi.

sentences.zh: 何休云：『弟無後兄之義，為亂昭穆之序，失父子之親，故不言仲孫，明不以子為父孫。

translations.literal: He Xiu explains: 'A younger brother has no right to succeed an elder brother; this would disorder the sequence of Zhao and Mu and lose the intimacy of father and son—therefore it does not say Zhong Sun, making clear that one does not treat a son as a father's grandson.'
translations.idiomatic: He Xiu explains: 'A younger brother has no right to succeed an elder brother; this would disorder the sequence of Zhao and Mu and sever the bond between father and son—therefore the text does not say Zhong Sun, making clear that one does not treat a son as his father's grandson.'

sentences.zh: 』晉賀循議兄弟不合繼位昭穆云：『商人六廟，親廟四，並契、湯而 六，比有兄弟四人相襲為君者，便當上毀四廟乎？

translations.literal: ' Jin He Xun, deliberating that brothers should not succeed one another in Zhao and Mu positions, stated: 'The Shang had six temples, four close temples, together with Qi and Tang making six—if there were four brothers succeeding one another as rulers, should the four close temples above be destroyed?
translations.idiomatic: ' He Xun of Jin argued that brothers should not succeed one another in Zhao and Mu positions: 'The Shang maintained six temples—four close temples, with Qi and Tang added to make six. If four brothers succeeded one another as rulers, should the four close temples above be destroyed?

sentences.zh: 如此，四世之親盡，無復祖禰之神矣。

translations.literal: If so, the intimacy of four generations would be exhausted, and there would no longer be spirits of ancestors and fathers.
translations.idiomatic: If so, the bond across four generations would be severed, and the spirits of ancestors and fathers would no longer be honored.

sentences.zh: 』溫嶠議兄弟相繼、藏主夾室之事云：『若以一帝為一世，則當不得祭於 禰，乃不及庶人之祭也。

translations.literal: ' Wen Jiao, deliberating on brothers succeeding one another and storing spirit tablets in collateral chambers, stated: 'If each emperor counts as one generation, then one ought not sacrifice to one's father—this would not even reach the sacrifices of commoners.'
translations.idiomatic: ' Wen Jiao, deliberating on brotherly succession and storing spirit tablets in collateral chambers, argued: 'If each emperor counts as a separate generation, one could no longer sacrifice to one's father—a situation worse than the rites allowed commoners.'

sentences.zh: 』夫兄弟同世，於恩既順，於義無否。

translations.literal: ' That brothers belong to the same generation is compliant in affection and unobjectionable in principle.
translations.idiomatic: ' That brothers belong to the same generation is harmonious in affection and unobjectionable in principle.

sentences.zh: 玄宗朝禘袷，皇伯考中宗、皇考睿宗同列於穆位。

translations.literal: At the di and xia sacrifices in the reign of Emperor Xuanzong, Imperial Elder Uncle-Emperor Zhongzong and Imperial Father-Emperor Ruizong were arrayed together in the Mu position.
translations.idiomatic: At the di and xia sacrifices in Xuanzong's reign, Imperial Elder Uncle-Emperor Zhongzong and Imperial Father-Emperor Ruizong were arrayed together in the Mu position.

sentences.zh: 德宗亦以中宗為高伯祖。

translations.literal: Emperor Dezong also addressed Zhongzong as great elder uncle-grandfather.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Dezong likewise addressed Zhongzong as great elder uncle-grandfather.

sentences.zh: 晉王導、荀崧議『大宗無 子，則立支子』，又曰『為人後者為之子』，無兄弟相為之文。

translations.literal: Jin Wang Dao and Xun Song deliberated that 'if the major lineage has no son, then establish a branch son,' and also said 'one who becomes another's heir is considered his son'—there is no text on brothers succeeding one another.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Dao and Xun Song of Jin argued that 'if the major lineage has no son, a branch son should be established,' and cited the dictum that 'one who becomes another's heir is considered his son'—but offered no precedent for brothers succeeding one another.

sentences.zh: 所以舍至親取遠屬者，蓋以兄弟一體，無父子之道故也。

translations.literal: The reason for setting aside the closest kin and selecting distant collateral kin is surely that brothers are of one body and lack the way of father and son.
translations.idiomatic: The reason for setting aside the closest kin and selecting distant collateral kin is that brothers are of one body and lack the bond between father and son.

sentences.zh: 竊以七廟之制，百王是尊。

translations.literal: I privately hold that the system of seven temples is honored by a hundred kings.
translations.idiomatic: I hold that the system of seven temples has been honored by a hundred kings.

sentences.zh: 至於祖有功，宗 有德，則百世不遷之廟也；

translations.literal: As for zu honoring merit and zong honoring virtue, these are temples never moved for a hundred generations;
translations.idiomatic: As for a zu honoring merit and a zong honoring virtue, these are temples never displaced for a hundred generations;

sentences.zh: 父為昭，子為穆，則千古不刊之典也。

translations.literal: father as Zhao, son as Mu—this is the canon never altered for a thousand ages.
translations.idiomatic: father as Zhao, son as Mu—this is the canon never altered for a thousand ages.

sentences.zh: 今議者引《漢書》曰：『為人後者為之子。

translations.literal: Now the deliberators cite the Han shu: 'One who becomes another's heir is considered his son.'
translations.idiomatic: Those who argue against us cite the Han shu: 'One who becomes another's heir is considered his son.'

sentences.zh: 』殊不知弟不為兄後，子不為父孫，《春秋》之深旨。

translations.literal: ' They do not realize that a younger brother does not succeed an elder brother, and a son does not become his father's grandson—the profound intent of the Spring and Autumn Annals.
translations.idiomatic: ' They overlook the Spring and Autumn Annals' deeper teaching: a younger brother does not succeed an elder brother, and a son does not become his father's grandson.

sentences.zh: 父謂之昭，子謂之穆，《禮記》之明文也。

translations.literal: Father is called Zhao, son is called Mu—the explicit text of the Book of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Father is called Zhao, son is called Mu—the explicit text of the Book of Rites.

sentences.zh: 又按太宗享祀太祖二十有二載，稱曰『孝弟』，此不易之制，又安可追改乎？

translations.literal: Moreover, Taizong sacrificed to Taizu for twenty-two years, styled as 'Filial Younger Brother'—this is an unalterable institution; how can it be retroactively changed?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Taizong sacrificed to Taizu for twenty-two years under the style 'Filial Younger Brother'—an established institution that cannot now be retroactively altered.

sentences.zh: 唐玄宗謂中宗為皇伯考，德宗謂中宗為高伯 祖，則伯氏之稱，復何不可？

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong called Zhongzong Imperial Elder Uncle-Emperor; Emperor Dezong called Zhongzong great elder uncle-grandfather—if so, what objection can there be to the address of elder uncle?
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong called Zhongzong Imperial Elder Uncle-Emperor; Emperor Dezong called him great elder uncle-grandfather—what objection, then, can there be to the address of elder uncle?

sentences.zh: 臣等參議：自今合祭日，太祖、太宗依典禮同位異坐，皇帝於太祖仍稱孝子，餘並遵舊制。」

translations.literal: We your subjects jointly deliberate: from this day of the joint sacrifice onward, Taizu and Taizong shall follow canonical ritual in the same position but separate seats; the emperor in Taizu's presence shall still be styled Filial Son; the rest shall follow the old regulations."
translations.idiomatic: We jointly recommend: henceforth, on days of joint sacrifice, Taizu and Taizong shall follow canonical ritual—same position but separate seats—and the emperor shall still be styled 'Filial Son' before Taizu; all other arrangements shall follow established practice."

sentences.zh: 乾興元年十月，奉真宗神主祔廟，以章 穆皇后郭氏配。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the first year of Qianxing, the spirit tablet of Zhenzong was brought and enshrined collaterally in the temple, with Empress Zhangmu, Lady Guo, as consort.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of 1022, Zhenzong's spirit tablet was installed in the temple, with Empress Zhangmu, née Guo, enshrined as consort.

sentences.zh: 康定元年，直秘閣趙希言奏：「太廟自來有寢無廟，因堂為室，東西十六間，內十四間為七室，兩首各一夾室。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangding, Direct Secretary Zhao Xiyan memorialized: "The Grand Temple from the beginning has had a sleeping hall but no temple hall; chambers were made from the main hall. East and west, sixteen bays; within, fourteen bays form seven chambers; at each end, one collateral chamber.
translations.idiomatic: In 1040, Direct Secretary Zhao Xiyan memorialized: "The Grand Temple has always had a sleeping hall but no separate temple hall, its chambers fashioned from the main hall—sixteen bays east and west, fourteen within forming seven chambers, with one collateral chamber at each end.

sentences.zh: 按禮，天子七廟，親廟五、祧廟二。

translations.literal: According to ritual, the Son of Heaven has seven temples: five close temples and two lineage temples.
translations.idiomatic: According to ritual, the Son of Heaven maintains seven temples—five close temples and two lineage temples.

sentences.zh: 據古則僖、順二神當遷。

translations.literal: According to antiquity, the spirits of Ancestors Xi and Shun ought to be moved.
translations.idiomatic: By ancient precedent, the spirits of Ancestors Xi and Shun ought to be moved.

sentences.zh: 國家道觀佛寺，並建別殿，奉安神御，豈若每主為一廟一寢。

translations.literal: The state's Daoist abbeys and Buddhist temples all build separate halls to install imperial spirit likenesses—how much better if each lord had one temple and one sleeping hall.
translations.idiomatic: The state's Daoist abbeys and Buddhist temples each erect separate halls for imperial spirit likenesses—how much better if each sovereign had his own temple and sleeping hall.

sentences.zh: 或前立一廟，以今十六間為寢，更立一祧廟，逐室各題廟號。

translations.literal: Or build a temple hall in front, use the present sixteen bays as the sleeping hall, and additionally establish a lineage temple, inscribing each chamber with its temple name.
translations.idiomatic: We might build a temple hall in front, retain the present sixteen bays as the sleeping hall, and additionally establish a lineage temple, inscribing each chamber with its temple name.

sentences.zh: 釦寶神御物，宜 銷毀之。

translations.literal: Spirit likenesses and precious objects should be destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit likenesses and precious objects associated with them should be destroyed.

sentences.zh: 」同判太常寺宋祁言：「周制有廟有寢，以象人君前有朝後有寢也。

translations.literal: " Co-director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Song Qi stated: "Under the Zhou system there were both temple halls and sleeping halls, symbolizing that the ruler had a court in front and a sleeping quarters behind.
translations.idiomatic: " Co-director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Song Qi replied: "Under the Zhou system there were both temple halls and sleeping halls, symbolizing the ruler's court in front and private quarters behind.

sentences.zh: 廟藏木主，寢藏衣冠。

translations.literal: The temple stored wooden spirit tablets; the sleeping hall stored robes and caps.
translations.idiomatic: The temple stored wooden spirit tablets; the sleeping hall stored robes and caps.

sentences.zh: 至秦乃出寢於墓側，故陵上更稱寢殿，後世因之。

translations.literal: By Qin the sleeping hall was moved out beside the tomb; hence on the mausoleum mound it came to be called the sleeping hall, and later ages followed this.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Qin the sleeping hall was moved beside the tomb mound, which came to be called the sleeping hall on the mausoleum—a practice later ages inherited.

sentences.zh: 今宗廟無寢， 蓋本於茲。

translations.literal: That the ancestral temple today has no sleeping hall surely originates in this.
translations.idiomatic: That our ancestral temple today has no sleeping hall surely originates in this development.

sentences.zh: 鄭康成謂周制立二昭二穆，與太祖、文、武共為七廟，此一家之說，未足援正。

translations.literal: Zheng Xuan held that under the Zhou system two Zhao and two Mu were established, together with the Great Ancestor, King Wen, and King Wu making seven temples—this is the opinion of one school and is insufficient to cite as correction.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Xuan held that the Zhou established two Zhao and two Mu, together with the Great Ancestor, King Wen, and King Wu, to make seven temples—but this is the opinion of one school and cannot be cited as authoritative correction.

sentences.zh: 自荀卿、王肅等皆云天子七廟，諸侯五，大夫三，士一，降殺以兩。

translations.literal: From Xun Qing, Wang Su, and others, all say the Son of Heaven has seven temples, feudal lords five, grand masters three, officers one—descending by steps of two.
translations.idiomatic: From Xun Qing and Wang Su onward, all agree that the Son of Heaven maintains seven temples, feudal lords five, grand masters three, and officers one—descending by steps of two.

sentences.zh: 則國 家七世之數，不用康成之說也。

translations.literal: Thus the state's count of seven generations does not use Zheng Xuan's theory.
translations.idiomatic: Thus our dynasty's count of seven generations does not follow Zheng Xuan's theory.

sentences.zh: 僖祖至真宗方及六世，不應便立祧廟。

translations.literal: From Ancestor Xi to Zhenzong there are only six generations; a lineage temple should not yet be established.
translations.idiomatic: From Ancestor Xi to Zhenzong there are only six generations; a lineage temple should not yet be established.

sentences.zh: 自周、漢每帝各立廟，晉、宋以來多同殿異室，國朝以七室代七廟，相承已久，不可輕改。

translations.literal: From Zhou and Han, each emperor established a separate temple; from Jin and Song onward many shared one hall with separate chambers; our dynasty uses seven chambers in place of seven temples—a practice inherited for long and not to be lightly altered.
translations.idiomatic: From Zhou and Han times each emperor maintained a separate temple; from Jin and Song onward most regimes used one hall with separate chambers; our dynasty substitutes seven chambers for seven temples—a practice long established and not to be lightly altered.

sentences.zh: 《周禮》：『天府掌祖廟之守藏。

translations.literal: The Rites of Zhou states: 'The Celestial Repository oversees the guarded stores of the ancestral temples.'
translations.idiomatic: The Rites of Zhou states: "The Celestial Repository oversees the guarded stores of the ancestral temples."

sentences.zh: 』寶物世傳者皆在焉。

translations.literal: ' All precious objects handed down through the generations are kept there.
translations.idiomatic: " All precious objects handed down through the generations are kept there.

sentences.zh: 其神御法物、寶盝、釦床，請別為庫藏之。

translations.literal: The spirit likenesses, ritual implements, precious cases, and carved beds— we request that these be stored separately in a repository.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit likenesses, ritual implements, precious cases, and carved beds should be stored separately in a dedicated repository.

sentences.zh: 」自是室題廟號，而建神御庫焉。

translations.literal: " Thereafter each chamber was inscribed with its temple name, and the Spirit Likeness Repository was built.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereafter each chamber was inscribed with its temple name, and the Spirit Likeness Repository was established.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐年，仁宗將 祔廟，修奉太廟使蔡襄上八室圖，為十八間。

translations.literal: In the Jiayou era, when Renzong was about to be enshrined collaterally in the temple, Commissioner for Maintaining the Grand Temple Cai Xiang submitted a diagram of eight chambers, totaling eighteen bays.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jiayou era, as Renzong was about to be installed in the temple, Commissioner for Maintaining the Grand Temple Cai Xiang submitted a plan for eight chambers spanning eighteen bays.

sentences.zh: 初，禮院請增廟室，孫抃等以為：「七世之廟，據父子而言，兄弟則昭、穆同，不得以世數之。

translations.literal: At first the Court of Ritual requested additional temple chambers. Sun Bian and others held: "The temple of seven generations is reckoned in terms of father and son; brothers share the same Zhao or Mu and cannot be counted by generation number.
translations.idiomatic: Initially the Court of Ritual requested additional temple chambers. Sun Bian and others argued: "A temple of seven generations is reckoned in terms of father and son; brothers share the same Zhao or Mu position and cannot be counted by generation number.

sentences.zh: 廟有始祖、有太祖、有 太宗、有中宗。

translations.literal: A temple has a founding ancestor, a Great Ancestor, a Grand Ancestor, and a Central Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: A temple system includes a founding ancestor, a Great Ancestor, a Grand Ancestor, and a Central Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 若以一君為一世，則小乙之祭不及其父。

translations.literal: If each ruler counts as one generation, then the sacrifices of Xiao Yi would not reach his father.
translations.idiomatic: If each ruler counted as a separate generation, the sacrifices of Xiao Yi would not reach his father.

sentences.zh: 故晉之廟十一室而六世，唐之廟十一室而九世。

translations.literal: Therefore Jin's temple had eleven chambers but six generations; Tang's temple had eleven chambers but nine generations.
translations.idiomatic: Thus Jin's temple had eleven chambers spanning six generations, while Tang's had eleven chambers spanning nine generations.

sentences.zh: 國朝太祖之室，太宗稱孝弟，真宗稱孝子，大行稱孝孫。

translations.literal: In our dynasty, in Taizu's chamber Taizong was styled Filial Younger Brother; Zhenzong, Filial Son; the late emperor, Filial Grandson.
translations.idiomatic: In our dynasty, Taizong was styled "Filial Younger Brother" in Taizu's chamber, Zhenzong "Filial Son," and the late emperor "Filial Grandson."

sentences.zh: 而 《禘袷圖》：太祖、太宗同居昭位，南向；

translations.literal: Moreover, the Diagram of Di and Xia Sacrifices shows Taizu and Taizong sharing the Zhao position, facing south;
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the Diagram of Di and Xia Sacrifices shows Taizu and Taizong sharing the Zhao position, facing south;

sentences.zh: 真宗居穆位，北向。

translations.literal: Zhenzong occupying the Mu position, facing north.
translations.idiomatic: with Zhenzong in the Mu position, facing north.

sentences.zh: 蓋先朝稽用古禮，著之祀典。

translations.literal: This is because the former court examined and applied ancient ritual, inscribing it in the sacrificial canon.
translations.idiomatic: The former court had examined ancient ritual and inscribed this arrangement in the sacrificial canon.

sentences.zh: 大行神主祔廟，請增為八室，以備天子事七世之禮。

translations.literal: When the late emperor's spirit tablet is enshrined collaterally in the temple, we request increasing to eight chambers to complete the Son of Heaven's rites for seven generations.
translations.idiomatic: When the late emperor's spirit tablet is installed in the temple, we request expanding to eight chambers to fulfill the Son of Heaven's rites for seven generations.

sentences.zh: 」盧士宗、司馬光 以為：「太祖已上之主，雖屬尊於太祖，親盡則遷。

translations.literal: " Lu Shizong and Sima Guang held: "The lords above Taizu, though ranked above Taizu in dignity, when intimacy is exhausted are moved.
translations.idiomatic: " Lu Shizong and Sima Guang argued: "The ancestors above Taizu, though more distant in rank than Taizu, must be moved when the bond of intimacy is exhausted.

sentences.zh: 故漢元之世，太上廟主瘞於寢園；

translations.literal: Therefore in the era of Han Yuandi, the spirit tablet of the Grand Supreme Temple was buried in the sleeping garden;
translations.idiomatic: Thus in Han Yuandi's reign the spirit tablet of the Grand Supreme Temple was buried in the sleeping garden;

sentences.zh: 魏明之世，處士廟主遷於園邑；

translations.literal: in the era of Wei Mingdi, the spirit tablet of the Recluse Temple was moved to the garden settlement;
translations.idiomatic: under Wei Mingdi the spirit tablet of the Recluse Temple was moved to the garden settlement;

sentences.zh: 晉武祔廟，遷征西府君；

translations.literal: when Jin Wudi enshrined collaterally in the temple, the Lord of the Western Campaign was moved;
translations.idiomatic: when Jin Wudi installed a new spirit tablet, the Lord of the Western Campaign was moved;

sentences.zh: 惠帝祔廟，遷豫章府 君。

translations.literal: when Huidi enshrined collaterally in the temple, the Lord of Yuzhang was moved.
translations.idiomatic: and when Huidi did the same, the Lord of Yuzhang was moved.

sentences.zh: 自是以下，大抵過六世則遷。

translations.literal: From this downward, in general when more than six generations had passed, they were moved.
translations.idiomatic: From this point onward, spirits were generally moved once more than six generations had passed.

sentences.zh: 蓋太祖未正東向，故上祀三昭三穆；

translations.literal: This is because before the Great Ancestor was properly oriented eastward, above him three Zhao and three Mu were sacrificed to;
translations.idiomatic: Before the Great Ancestor was properly oriented eastward, the court sacrificed to three Zhao and three Mu above him;

sentences.zh: 巳正東向，則並昭、穆為七世。

translations.literal: once properly oriented eastward, then Zhao and Mu together made seven generations.
translations.idiomatic: once he faced eastward, Zhao and Mu together constituted seven generations.

sentences.zh: 唐初祀四世，太宗增祀六世。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tang, four generations were sacrificed to; Taizong increased sacrifices to six generations.
translations.idiomatic: Early Tang sacrificed to four generations; Taizong expanded this to six.

sentences.zh: 及太宗祔廟，則遷弘農府君，高 宗祔廟，又遷宣帝，皆祀六世，前世成法也。

translations.literal: When Taizong was enshrined collaterally in the temple, the Lord of Hongnong was moved; when Gaozong was enshrined collaterally, Emperor Xuan was again moved—all sacrificing to six generations, the established law of former ages.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong's tablet was installed, the Lord of Hongnong was moved; when Gaozong's was installed, Emperor Xuan was moved again—each dynasty sacrificing to six generations, the established law of former ages.

sentences.zh: 玄宗立九室祀八世，事不經見。

translations.literal: Xuanzong established nine chambers sacrificing to eight generations—a matter without precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong's establishment of nine chambers for eight generations had no precedent.

sentences.zh: 若以太祖、太宗為一世，則大行祔廟，僖祖親盡，當遷夾室，祀三昭三穆，於先王典禮 及近世之制，無不符合。

translations.literal: If Taizu and Taizong are treated as one generation, then when the late emperor is enshrined collaterally, Ancestor Xi's intimacy is exhausted and he ought to be moved to a collateral chamber, sacrificing to three Zhao and three Mu—in the canonical rites of former kings and the institutions of recent times, nothing fails to conform.
translations.idiomatic: If Taizu and Taizong are treated as one generation, then when the late emperor's tablet is installed, Ancestor Xi's bond of intimacy will be exhausted and he should be moved to a collateral chamber, with sacrifices offered to three Zhao and three Mu—a arrangement conforming both to ancient canonical rites and recent practice.

sentences.zh: 」抃等復議曰：「自唐至周，廟製不同，而皆七世。

translations.literal: " Bian and others deliberated again: "From Tang to Zhou, temple systems differed, yet all had seven generations.
translations.idiomatic: " Sun Bian and others replied: "From Tang to Zhou, temple systems differed, yet all maintained seven generations.

sentences.zh: 自周以上，所謂太祖，非始受命之主，特始封之君而已。

translations.literal: From Zhou upward, what was called the Great Ancestor was not the lord who first received the Mandate, but merely the lord of the first enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: Before Zhou times, the so-called Great Ancestor was not the ruler who first received the Mandate, but merely the lord of the first enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 今僖祖雖非始封之君，要為立 廟之祖，方廟數未過七世，遂毀其廟，遷其主，考之三代，禮未有此。

translations.literal: Now although Ancestor Xi was not the lord of the first enfeoffment, he is nevertheless the ancestor who established the temple; the temple count has not yet exceeded seven generations, yet his temple is destroyed and his tablet moved—examining the Three Dynasties, ritual has never had this.
translations.idiomatic: Although Ancestor Xi was not the lord of the first enfeoffment, he is nevertheless the ancestor who established our temple system; our temple count has not yet exceeded seven generations, yet his temple would be destroyed and his tablet moved—nothing of the kind appears in the ritual of the Three Dynasties.

sentences.zh: 漢、魏及唐一時之議，恐未合先王制禮之意。

translations.literal: The deliberations of Han, Wei, and Tang at particular moments perhaps do not accord with the intent of the former kings in establishing ritual.
translations.idiomatic: The expedients of Han, Wei, and Tang at particular moments likely do not accord with the former kings' intent in establishing ritual.

sentences.zh: 」乃存僖祖室以備七室。

translations.literal: " Thereupon Ancestor Xi's chamber was retained to complete seven chambers.
translations.idiomatic: " Ancestor Xi's chamber was therefore retained to complete the seven chambers.

sentences.zh: 治平四年，英宗將祔廟，太常禮院請以神主祔第八室，祧藏僖祖及文懿皇后神主於西夾室。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhiping, when Yingzong was about to be enshrined collaterally in the temple, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ritual requested that the spirit tablet be enshrined in the eighth chamber, and that the spirit tablets of Ancestor Xi and Empress Wenyi be moved to lineage storage in the western collateral chamber.
translations.idiomatic: In 1067, as Yingzong was about to be installed in the temple, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ritual requested that his spirit tablet occupy the eighth chamber and that the tablets of Ancestor Xi and Empress Wenyi be moved to lineage storage in the western collateral chamber.

sentences.zh: 自仁宗而上，以次遞遷。

translations.literal: From Renzong upward, each was moved in succession.
translations.idiomatic: From Renzong upward, each ancestor was shifted in succession.

sentences.zh: 翰林承旨張方平等議：「同堂八室，廟製已定，僖祖當祧，合於典禮。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician-in-Chief Zhang Fangping and others deliberated: "Eight chambers in one hall—the temple system is already fixed; Ancestor Xi ought to be moved to lineage status, in accord with canonical ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin Academician-in-Chief Zhang Fangping and others argued: "With eight chambers in one hall, the temple system is already fixed; Ancestor Xi should be moved to lineage status, in accord with canonical ritual.

sentences.zh: 」乃於九月奉安八室神主，祧僖祖及後，祔英宗，罷僖祖諱及文懿皇后忌日。

translations.literal: " Thereupon in the ninth month the spirit tablets of the eight chambers were installed; Ancestor Xi and his consort were moved to lineage status; Yingzong was enshrined collaterally; and the taboo days of Ancestor Xi and Empress Wenyi were discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: " In the ninth month the eight spirit tablets were installed; Ancestor Xi and his consort were moved to lineage status; Yingzong was installed; and the taboo days of Ancestor Xi and Empress Wenyi were discontinued.

sentences.zh: 熙寧五年，中書門下言：「僖祖以上世次，不可得而知，則僖祖有廟，與商周契、稷疑無以異。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xining, the Secretariat stated: "The generations above Ancestor Xi cannot be known; that Ancestor Xi has a temple perhaps differs in no way from Qi and Ji of Shang and Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: In 1072, the Secretariat argued: "The generations above Ancestor Xi cannot be known; that he maintains a temple may differ in no essential way from Qi and Ji of Shang and Zhou.

sentences.zh: 今毀其廟而藏主夾室，替祖考之尊而下祔於子孫，殆非所以順祖宗孝心、事亡如存之義。

translations.literal: Now to destroy his temple and store his tablet in a collateral chamber, displacing the dignity of the ancestral grandfather and enshrining him collaterally below descendants—this is hardly the way to follow the filial heart of the ancestors or treat the dead as if living.
translations.idiomatic: To destroy his temple and store his tablet in a collateral chamber, displacing our founding ancestor's dignity and ranking him below his descendants, hardly accords with filial devotion to the ancestors or the principle of treating the dead as if they were still living.

sentences.zh: 請以所奏付兩製議，取其當者。

translations.literal: We request that the memorial be referred to deliberation by both academies, and that what is fitting be selected.
translations.idiomatic: We request that the memorial be referred to both Hanlin academies for deliberation, and that the fitting course be adopted.

sentences.zh: 」時王安石為相，不主祧遷之說，故復有是請。

translations.literal: " At the time Wang Anshi was chief minister and did not uphold the theory of lineage removal and transfer; hence this request was made again.
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Anshi was then chief minister and did not support removing ancestors to lineage status; hence this renewed petition.

sentences.zh: 翰林學士元絳等上議曰：「自古受命之王，既以功德享有天下，皆推其本統以尊事其祖。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician Yuan Jiang and others submitted a deliberation: "From antiquity, kings who received the Mandate, having by merit and virtue possessed the realm, all traced their original line to honor and serve their ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin Academician Yuan Jiang and others memorialized: "From antiquity, every king who received the Mandate, having by merit and virtue won the realm, traced his original line to honor his founding ancestor.

sentences.zh: 故商、周以契、稷有功於唐、虞之際，故謂之祖有功，若必以有功而為 祖，則夏後氏不郊鯀矣。

translations.literal: Therefore Shang and Zhou, because Qi and Ji had merit in the era of Tang and Yu, called them ancestors of merit; but if merit alone must make one an ancestor, then the House of Xia would not have sacrificed at the suburban altar to Gun.
translations.idiomatic: Shang and Zhou honored Qi and Ji as ancestors of merit because of their service in the era of Tang and Yu; but if merit alone were required, the House of Xia would never have sacrificed to Gun at the suburban altar.

sentences.zh: 今太祖受命之初，立親廟，自僖祖以上世次，既不可知，則僖祖之為始祖無疑矣。

translations.literal: Now at the beginning when Taizu received the Mandate, close temples were established; the generations above Ancestor Xi cannot be known—then that Ancestor Xi is the founding ancestor is without doubt.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizu received the Mandate he established close ancestral temples; since the generations above Ancestor Xi cannot be known, he is unquestionably our founding ancestor.

sentences.zh: 儻謂僖祖不當比契、稷為始祖，是使天下之人不復知尊 祖，而子孫得以有功加其祖考也。

translations.literal: If one says Ancestor Xi ought not be compared to Qi and Ji as founding ancestor, this would cause the people of the realm no longer to know how to honor ancestors, and descendants could add merit to their grandfathers and fathers.
translations.idiomatic: To deny Ancestor Xi the status accorded Qi and Ji would teach the realm to cease honoring ancestors and allow descendants to elevate their forebears based on personal merit.

sentences.zh: 《傳》曰：『毀廟之主，陳於太祖；

translations.literal: The Commentary states: 'The tablets of destroyed temples are displayed before the Great Ancestor;
translations.idiomatic: The Commentary states: "The tablets of destroyed temples are displayed before the Great Ancestor;

sentences.zh: 未毀廟之主，皆升，合食於太祖。

translations.literal: the tablets of temples not yet destroyed all ascend and share a joint meal at the Great Ancestor.'
translations.idiomatic: the tablets of temples not yet destroyed all ascend and share a joint meal at the Great Ancestor."

sentences.zh: 』今遷僖祖之主，藏於太祖之室，則是四祖袷祭之日，皆降 而合食也。

translations.literal: ' Now to move Ancestor Xi's tablet and store it in Taizu's chamber means that on the day of the xia sacrifice to the four ancestors, all descend and share a joint meal.
translations.idiomatic: " Moving Ancestor Xi's tablet into Taizu's chamber would mean that on the day of the xia sacrifice to the four ancestors, all would descend to share a joint meal together.

sentences.zh: 請以僖祖之廟為太祖，則合於先王禮意。

translations.literal: We request that Ancestor Xi's temple be made the Great Ancestor—then it accords with the ritual intent of the former kings.
translations.idiomatic: We request that Ancestor Xi's temple be designated the Great Ancestor—this would accord with the ritual intent of the former kings.

sentences.zh: 」翰林學士韓維議曰：「昔先王有天下，跡其基業之所起，奉以為太祖。

translations.literal: " Hanlin Academician Han Wei deliberated: "In former times when the former kings possessed the realm, they traced where their foundation and enterprise arose and honored it as the Great Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: " Hanlin Academician Han Wei argued: "Former kings who won the realm traced where their foundation began and honored that figure as the Great Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 故子夏序《詩》，稱文、武之功起於後 稷。

translations.literal: Therefore Zixia, in ordering the Odes, said the achievements of Wen and Wu arose from Hou Ji.
translations.idiomatic: Thus Zixia, in ordering the Odes, traced the achievements of Wen and Wu back to Hou Ji.

sentences.zh: 後世有天下者，特起無所因，故遂為一代太祖。

translations.literal: Later-age rulers who possessed the realm arose specially without anything to follow; hence they themselves became the Great Ancestor of a generation.
translations.idiomatic: Later rulers who rose without such antecedents became the Great Ancestor of their own dynasty.

sentences.zh: 太祖皇帝功德卓然，為宋太祖，無少議者。

translations.literal: Taizu emperor's merit and virtue were outstanding; as Song's Great Ancestor, there is scarcely any dispute.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizu's merit and virtue were outstanding; as Song's Great Ancestor, this is beyond dispute.

sentences.zh: 僖祖雖為高祖，然仰跡功業，未見所因，上尋世係，又不知所以始， 若以所事契、稷奉之，竊恐於古無考，而於今亦所未安。

translations.literal: Although Ancestor Xi is great-great-grandfather, yet tracing upward his achievements and enterprise, nothing is seen to follow from; tracing upward the genealogical line, one does not know where it begins—if Qi and Ji whom he is served as are honored, I fear this cannot be verified in antiquity and is also not settled for today.
translations.idiomatic: Although Ancestor Xi is our great-great-grandfather, tracing his achievements reveals no clear antecedent, and his genealogical origins are unknown; to honor him as one would Qi and Ji seems unsupported by antiquity and unsettling in the present.

sentences.zh: 今之廟室與古殊製，古者每廟異宮，今祖宗同處一室，則西夾室在順祖之右，考之尊卑之次，似亦無嫌。」

translations.literal: Today's temple chambers differ in system from antiquity; in antiquity each temple had a separate palace; today the ancestors share one chamber—then the western collateral chamber is to the right of Ancestor Shun; examining the order of dignity and baseness, there seems no objection either."
translations.idiomatic: Our temple chambers differ from ancient practice, where each shrine had its own hall; today the ancestors share one chamber, placing the western collateral chamber to the right of Ancestor Shun—a arrangement that, judged by the order of dignity, seems unobjectionable."

sentences.zh: 天章閣待制孫固請：「特為僖祖立室，由太祖而上，親盡迭毀之主皆藏之。

translations.literal: Awaited Gentleman of the Hall of Heavenly Patterns Sun Gu requested: "Establish a chamber specially for Ancestor Xi; from Taizu upward, all tablets of lords whose intimacy is exhausted and temples destroyed in succession are stored there.
translations.idiomatic: Awaited Gentleman of the Hall of Heavenly Patterns Sun Gu proposed: "Establish a chamber specially for Ancestor Xi, storing there all tablets of ancestors from Taizu upward whose temples have been destroyed once intimacy is exhausted.

sentences.zh: 當禘袷時，以僖祖權居東向之位，太祖順昭穆之列而從之，取毀廟之主而合食，則僖祖 之尊自有所申。

translations.literal: At the time of di and xia sacrifices, let Ancestor Xi provisionally occupy the east-facing position; Taizu follows the Zhao and Mu ranks in attendance; taking the tablets of destroyed temples for a joint meal—then Ancestor Xi's dignity is itself expressed.
translations.idiomatic: At the di and xia sacrifices, Ancestor Xi would provisionally occupy the east-facing position while Taizu follows in proper Zhao and Mu order; gathering the tablets of destroyed temples for a joint meal would thereby express Ancestor Xi's proper dignity.

sentences.zh: 以僖祖立廟為非，則周人別廟薑原，不可謂非禮。

translations.literal: If establishing a temple for Ancestor Xi is wrong, then the Zhou people's separate temple for Jiang Yuan cannot be called unritual.
translations.idiomatic: If establishing a separate temple for Ancestor Xi is improper, then the Zhou's separate temple for Jiang Yuan could hardly be called unritual either.

sentences.zh: 」秘閣校理王介請依《周官》守祧之制，創祧廟以奉僖祖，庶不下祔子孫夾室，以替遠祖之尊。

translations.literal: " Secretariat Compiler Wang Jie requested following the Rites of Zhou system of guarding the lineage shrine, creating a lineage temple to honor Ancestor Xi, so as not to enshine him collaterally below descendants in a collateral chamber, displacing the dignity of a distant ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: " Secretariat Compiler Wang Jie proposed following the Rites of Zhou system of guarding the lineage shrine by creating a lineage temple for Ancestor Xi, thereby avoiding ranking our distant founding ancestor below his descendants in a collateral chamber.

sentences.zh: 帝以維之說近是，而安石以維言夾室在右為尊為非理，帝亦然之。

translations.literal: The emperor considered Wei's view nearly correct, but Wang Anshi held that Wei's saying the collateral chamber on the right is more honored was unreasonable; the emperor also agreed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor found Han Wei's view nearly persuasive, but Wang Anshi rejected Wei's claim that the collateral chamber on the right was the more honored position; the emperor agreed with Wang.

sentences.zh: 又安石以尊僖祖為始祖，則郊祀當以配天，若宗祀明堂，則太祖、太宗當迭配帝。

translations.literal: Moreover Wang Anshi held that if Ancestor Xi is honored as founding ancestor, then at the suburban sacrifice he ought to be paired with Heaven; if sacrificing to ancestors at the Bright Hall, then Taizu and Taizong ought to be paired with the Thearch in alternation.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi further argued that if Ancestor Xi were honored as founding ancestor, he should be paired with Heaven at the suburban sacrifice, while Taizu and Taizong should alternate as partners at Bright Hall ancestral rites.

sentences.zh: 又疑明堂以英宗配天，與僖祖為非始祖之說。

translations.literal: He also doubted pairing Yingzong with Heaven at the Bright Hall, which conflicted with the view that Ancestor Xi was not the founding ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: He also questioned pairing Yingzong with Heaven at the Bright Hall, which conflicted with treating Ancestor Xi as something other than the founding ancestor.

sentences.zh: 遂下禮官詳定。

translations.literal: Thereupon the matter was referred to ritual officials for detailed determination.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was therefore referred to the ritual officials for detailed determination.

sentences.zh: 同判太常寺兼禮儀事張師顏等議：「昔商、周之興，本於契、稷，故奉之為太祖。

translations.literal: Co-director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and concurrent Ritual Affairs Zhang Shiyan and others deliberated: "In former times the rise of Shang and Zhou was rooted in Qi and Ji; therefore they were honored as Great Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Co-director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Zhang Shiyan and others argued: "Shang and Zhou rose from Qi and Ji and therefore honored them as Great Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 後世受命之君，功業特起，不因先代，則親廟迭毀，身自為祖。

translations.literal: Later-age lords who received the Mandate, their achievements arising specially without following a prior age, then had close temples destroyed in succession and themselves became the ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Later rulers who received the Mandate through achievements arising independently of prior dynasties destroyed close temples in succession and became ancestors in their own right.

sentences.zh: 鄭玄雲『夏五廟 無太祖，禹與二昭二穆而已』，張薦雲『夏後以禹始封，遂為不遷之祖』是也。

translations.literal: Zheng Xuan said 'Xia had five temples without a Great Ancestor—only Yu with two Zhao and two Mu'; Zhang Jian said 'Xia honored Yu, who received the first enfeoffment, and thus he became the ancestor never moved'—this is correct.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Xuan held that "Xia maintained five temples without a Great Ancestor—only Yu with two Zhao and two Mu," while Zhang Jian argued that "Xia honored Yu, who received the first enfeoffment, as the immovable ancestor"—the latter view is correct.

sentences.zh: 若始封世近，上有親廟，則擬祖上遷，而太祖不毀。

translations.literal: If the first enfeoffment was recent and close temples existed above, then the putative ancestor was moved upward, while the Great Ancestor was not destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: If the first enfeoffment was recent and close temples existed above, the putative ancestor was moved upward while the Great Ancestor's temple remained intact.

sentences.zh: 魏祖武帝則處士迭毀，唐祖景帝 則弘農迭毀，此前世祖其始封之君，以法契、稷之明例也。

translations.literal: Wei honored Wudi as ancestor and the Recluse was destroyed in succession; Tang honored Jingdi as ancestor and Hongnong was destroyed in succession—these prior dynasties honored their lords of first enfeoffment, following the clear precedent of Qi and Ji.
translations.idiomatic: Wei honored Wudi as ancestor while the Recluse's temple was destroyed in succession; Tang honored Jingdi while Hongnong's was destroyed in succession—each prior dynasty honored its lord of first enfeoffment following the clear precedent of Qi and Ji.

sentences.zh: 唐韓愈有言：『事異商、周，禮從而變。

translations.literal: Tang's Han Yu had a saying: 'When affairs differ from Shang and Zhou, ritual follows and changes.'
translations.idiomatic: Han Yu of Tang wrote: "When circumstances differ from Shang and Zhou, ritual adapts accordingly."

sentences.zh: 』晉琅邪王德文曰：『七廟之義，自由德厚流光，享祀及遠，非 是為太祖申尊祖之祀。

translations.literal: ' Jin's Prince Dewen of Langye said: 'The meaning of seven temples lies in virtue being thick and glory flowing afar, sacrifices reaching the distant—it is not to extend honoring-the-ancestor sacrifices for the Great Ancestor.'
translations.idiomatic: " Jin's Prince Dewen of Langye argued: "The meaning of seven temples lies in virtue being profound and glory extending afar, with sacrifices reaching distant ancestors—it is not to extend ancestor-veneration sacrifices for the Great Ancestor."

sentences.zh: 』其說是也。

translations.literal: ' This view is correct.
translations.idiomatic: " This view is correct.

sentences.zh: 禮，天子七廟，而太祖之遠近不可以必，但雲三昭三穆與太祖之廟而七，未嘗言親廣之首，必為始祖也。

translations.literal: Ritual: the Son of Heaven has seven temples, yet whether the Great Ancestor is near or far cannot be fixed; it only says three Zhao, three Mu, and the temple of the Great Ancestor making seven—never saying that the head of the close and distant must be the founding ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual prescribes seven temples for the Son of Heaven, but whether the Great Ancestor is near or distant cannot be fixed; the canon only specifies three Zhao, three Mu, and the Great Ancestor's temple—never stating that the foremost of the close and distant must be the founding ancestor.

sentences.zh: 國家以僖祖親盡而祧 之，奉景祐之詔，以太祖為帝者之祖，是合於禮矣。

translations.literal: The state, because Ancestor Xi's intimacy was exhausted, moved him to lineage status; following the edict of Jingyou, Taizu is made the ancestor of emperors—this accords with ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty moved Ancestor Xi to lineage status once intimacy was exhausted and, following the Jingyou edict, made Taizu the ancestor of emperors—this accords with ritual.

sentences.zh: 張昭、任徹之徒，不能遠推隆極之制，因緣近比，請建四廟，遂使天子之禮下同諸侯。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhao, Ren Che, and their kind could not push far the system of supreme elevation; drawing on near comparisons, they requested establishing four temples—thus causing the Son of Heaven's ritual to sink to the level of feudal lords.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhao, Ren Che, and their associates failed to grasp the full system of supreme elevation; drawing on recent precedents, they petitioned for four temples, thereby reducing the Son of Heaven's ritual to the level of feudal lords.

sentences.zh: 若使廟數備六，則更當上 推兩世，而僖祖次在第三，亦未可謂之始祖也。

translations.literal: If temple count were made complete at six, then two more generations ought to be pushed upward—and Ancestor Xi would rank third, and also could not be called founding ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: If the temple count were expanded to six, two more generations would need to be added above—and Ancestor Xi would rank only third, and could hardly be called the founding ancestor.

sentences.zh: 謹按建隆四年，親郊崇配不及僖祖。

translations.literal: We respectfully note that in the fourth year of Jianlong, at the suburban sacrifice the lofty pairing did not reach Ancestor Xi.
translations.idiomatic: We note respectfully that at the suburban sacrifice in the fourth year of Jianlong, the lofty pairing did not include Ancestor Xi.

sentences.zh: 開國以來，大祭虛其東向，斯乃祖宗已行之意。

translations.literal: Since the founding of the state, at great sacrifices the east-facing position has been left vacant—this is the intent the ancestors have already carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Since the founding of the dynasty, great sacrifices have left the east-facing position vacant—an arrangement our ancestors have already established.

sentences.zh: 請略仿《周官》守祧之制，築別 廟以藏僖祖神主，大祭之歲，祀於其室。

translations.literal: We request roughly following the Rites of Zhou system of guarding the lineage shrine, building a separate temple to store Ancestor Xi's spirit tablet; in years of great sacrifice, sacrifice in its chamber.
translations.idiomatic: We request roughly following the Rites of Zhou system of guarding the lineage shrine by building a separate temple to house Ancestor Xi's spirit tablet, with sacrifices offered there in years of great sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 太廟則一依舊制，虛東向之位。

translations.literal: The Grand Temple should follow the old system entirely, leaving the east-facing position vacant.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Temple should follow the established system entirely, leaving the east-facing position vacant.

sentences.zh: 郊配之禮，則仍其舊。」

translations.literal: The suburban pairing ritual should remain as before."
translations.idiomatic: The suburban pairing ritual should remain unchanged."

sentences.zh: 同知太常禮院蘇棁請：「即景靈宮祔僖祖，即與唐祔 獻、懿二祖於興聖、明德廟，禮意無異。

translations.literal: Associate Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ritual Su Zong requested: "Enshrining Ancestor Xi collaterally at the Palace of Splendid Numen is in ritual intent no different from Tang's enshrining the two ancestors Xian and Yi collaterally at the temples of Exalted Sagacity and Bright Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Associate Director Su Zong of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ritual proposed: "Installing Ancestor Xi at the Palace of Splendid Numen differs in no essential way from Tang's installation of ancestors Xian and Yi at the temples of Exalted Sagacity and Bright Virtue.

sentences.zh: 」同判禮院周孟陽等言：「自僖祖而上，世次莫知，則僖祖為始祖無疑，宜以僖祖配感生帝。

translations.literal: " Co-director of the Court of Ritual Zhou Mengyang and others stated: "From Ancestor Xi upward, generations cannot be known—then Ancestor Xi as founding ancestor is without doubt; he ought to be paired with the Thearch of Felt Life.
translations.idiomatic: " Co-director Zhou Mengyang of the Court of Ritual argued: "Since the generations above Ancestor Xi cannot be known, he is unquestionably our founding ancestor and should be paired with the Thearch of Felt Life.

sentences.zh: 」章衡請：「尊僖祖為始祖， 而次祧順祖，以合子為父屈之義。

translations.literal: " Zhang Heng requested: "Honor Ancestor Xi as founding ancestor, and next move Ancestor Shun to lineage status, to accord with the principle that the son bends for the father.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhang Heng proposed: "Honor Ancestor Xi as founding ancestor and next move Ancestor Shun to lineage status, in accord with the principle that the son yields to the father.

sentences.zh: 推僖祖侑感生之祀，而罷宣祖配位，以合祖以孫尊之義，餘且如舊制。

translations.literal: Advance Ancestor Xi to assist at the sacrifice to Felt Life, and discontinue Ancestor Xuan's pairing position, to accord with the principle that the ancestor is honored by the grandson; the rest for now as in the old system.
translations.idiomatic: Advance Ancestor Xi to assist at the sacrifice to the Thearch of Felt Life and remove Ancestor Xuan from his pairing position, in accord with the principle that the ancestor is honored by the grandson; all else should follow established practice.

sentences.zh: 」而馮京欲以太祖正東向之位，安石力主元絳初議，遂從 之。

translations.literal: " But Feng Jing wished Taizu to occupy the proper east-facing position; Wang Anshi strongly upheld Yuan Jiang's initial deliberation, and the court followed it.
translations.idiomatic: " Feng Jing wished Taizu to occupy the proper east-facing position, but Wang Anshi strongly upheld Yuan Jiang's initial proposal, and the court followed Wang.

sentences.zh: 帝問：「配天孰始？

translations.literal: The emperor asked: "For pairing with Heaven, who begins?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked: "For pairing with Heaven, who should come first?

sentences.zh: 」安石曰：「宣祖見配感生帝，欲改以僖祖配。

translations.literal: " Wang Anshi said: "Ancestor Xuan is presently paired with the Thearch of Felt Life; we wish to change this so Ancestor Xi is paired.
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Anshi replied: "Ancestor Xuan is presently paired with the Thearch of Felt Life; we wish to change this so Ancestor Xi is paired instead.

sentences.zh: 」帝然之。

translations.literal: " The emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 於是請奉僖祖神主為始祖，遷順祖神主夾室，以僖祖配感生帝祀。

translations.literal: Thereupon it was requested to install Ancestor Xi's spirit tablet as founding ancestor, move Ancestor Shun's spirit tablet to a collateral chamber, and pair Ancestor Xi at the sacrifice to the Thearch of Felt Life.
translations.idiomatic: The court then requested installing Ancestor Xi's spirit tablet as founding ancestor, moving Ancestor Shun's tablet to a collateral chamber, and pairing Ancestor Xi at the sacrifice to the Thearch of Felt Life.

sentences.zh: 詔下太常禮院 詳定儀注。

translations.literal: An edict was issued to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ritual to determine the ceremonial regulations in detail.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ritual to determine the ceremonial regulations in detail.

sentences.zh: 安石本議以僖祖配天，帝不許，故更以配感生帝焉。

translations.literal: Wang Anshi had originally deliberated pairing Ancestor Xi with Heaven; the emperor did not permit this, and therefore he was instead paired with the Thearch of Felt Life.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi had originally proposed pairing Ancestor Xi with Heaven, but the emperor did not permit this, and he was instead paired with the Thearch of Felt Life.

sentences.zh: 元豐元年，詳定郊廟禮文所圖上八廟異宮之制，以始祖居中，分昭穆為左右。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanfeng, the office for determining suburban and temple ritual texts submitted a diagram of the system of eight temples in separate palaces, with the founding ancestor centered and Zhao and Mu divided to left and right.
translations.idiomatic: In 1078, the office for determining suburban and temple ritual texts submitted a plan for eight temples in separate halls, with the founding ancestor at the center and Zhao and Mu divided to left and right.

sentences.zh: 自北而 南，僖祖為始祖；

translations.literal: From north to south, Ancestor Xi as founding ancestor;
translations.idiomatic: From north to south: Ancestor Xi as founding ancestor;

sentences.zh: 翼祖、太祖、太宗、仁宗為穆，在右；

translations.literal: Ancestors Yi, Taizu, Taizong, and Renzong as Mu, on the right;
translations.idiomatic: Ancestors Yi, Taizu, Taizong, and Renzong as Mu, on the right;

sentences.zh: 宣祖、真宗、英宗為昭，在左。

translations.literal: Ancestors Xuan, Zhenzong, and Yingzong as Zhao, on the left.
translations.idiomatic: Ancestors Xuan, Zhenzong, and Yingzong as Zhao, on the left.

sentences.zh: 皆南面北上。

translations.literal: All faced south with north above.
translations.idiomatic: All faced south, ranked from north to south.

sentences.zh: 陸佃言：「太祖之廟百世不遷，三昭三穆，親盡則迭毀。

translations.literal: Lu Dian stated: "Taizu's temple is never moved for a hundred generations; three Zhao and three Mu—when intimacy is exhausted, temples are destroyed in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Dian argued: "Taizu's temple is never displaced for a hundred generations; among the three Zhao and three Mu, when intimacy is exhausted temples are destroyed in succession.

sentences.zh: 如周 以後稷為太祖，王季為昭，文王為穆，武王為昭，成王為穆，康王為昭，昭王為穆，其後穆王入廟，王季親盡而遷，則文王宜居昭位，武王宜居穆位，成王、昭王宜 居昭位，康王、穆王宜居穆位，所謂父昭子穆是也。

translations.literal: As in Zhou, with Hou Ji as Great Ancestor: Wang Ji as Zhao, King Wen as Mu, King Wu as Zhao, King Cheng as Mu, King Kang as Zhao, King Zhao as Mu—afterward when King Mu entered the temple and Wang Ji's intimacy was exhausted and he was moved, then King Wen ought to occupy the Zhao position, King Wu the Mu position, King Cheng and King Zhao the Zhao positions, King Kang and King Mu the Mu positions—this is what is called father as Zhao, son as Mu.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhou, with Hou Ji as Great Ancestor: Wang Ji was Zhao, King Wen Mu, King Wu Zhao, King Cheng Mu, King Kang Zhao, King Zhao Mu. When King Mu entered the temple and Wang Ji's intimacy was exhausted, King Wen should occupy the Zhao position, King Wu the Mu, King Cheng and King Zhao the Zhao positions, and King Kang and King Mu the Mu positions—this is the principle of father as Zhao, son as Mu.

sentences.zh: 說者以昭常為昭，穆常為穆，則尊卑失序。

translations.literal: Expositors who hold Zhao is always Zhao and Mu always Mu would cause dignity and baseness to lose order.
translations.idiomatic: Commentators who hold that Zhao is always Zhao and Mu always Mu would cause the order of dignity to collapse.

sentences.zh: 」復圖上八廟昭穆之制，以翼祖、太祖、太宗、仁宗為昭，在左；

translations.literal: " A revised diagram of the eight-temple Zhao and Mu system was submitted: Ancestors Yi, Taizu, Taizong, and Renzong as Zhao, on the left;
translations.idiomatic: " A revised diagram was submitted: Ancestors Yi, Taizu, Taizong, and Renzong as Zhao, on the left;

sentences.zh: 宣 祖、真宗、英宗為穆，在右。

translations.literal: Ancestors Xuan, Zhenzong, and Yingzong as Mu, on the right.
translations.idiomatic: Ancestors Xuan, Zhenzong, and Yingzong as Mu, on the right.

sentences.zh: 皆南面北上。

translations.literal: All faced south with north above.
translations.idiomatic: All faced south, ranked from north to south.

sentences.zh: 何洵直圖上八廟異宮，引熙寧儀：僖祖正東向之位，順祖、宣祖、真宗、英宗南面為昭，翼祖、太祖、太 宗、仁宗北面為穆，正得祖宗繼序、德厚流光之本意。

translations.literal: He Xunzhi submitted a diagram of eight temples in separate palaces, citing the Xining regulations: Ancestor Xi in the proper east-facing position; Ancestors Shun, Xuan, Zhenzong, and Yingzong on the south face as Zhao; Ancestors Yi, Taizu, Taizong, and Renzong on the north face as Mu—truly obtaining the original intent of ancestors succeeding in order and virtue being thick with glory flowing afar.
