translations.idiomatic: He Xunzhi submitted a plan for eight temples in separate halls, citing the Xining regulations: Ancestor Xi in the proper east-facing position; Ancestors Shun, Xuan, Zhenzong, and Yingzong on the south as Zhao; Ancestors Yi, Taizu, Taizong, and Renzong on the north as Mu—truly capturing the original intent of orderly succession and virtue extending across generations.

sentences.zh: 又以晉孫毓、唐賈公彥言「始祖居中，三昭在左，南面西上；

translations.literal: He also cited Jin's Sun Yu and Tang's Jia Gongyan, who said 'the founding ancestor is centered; three Zhao on the left, facing south with west above;
translations.idiomatic: He also cited Sun Yu of Jin and Jia Gongyan of Tang: "The founding ancestor stands at the center; the three Zhao on the left, facing south with west ranked above;

sentences.zh: 三穆在右，南面東上。

translations.literal: three Mu on the right, facing south with east above.'
translations.idiomatic: the three Mu on the right, facing south with east ranked above."

sentences.zh: 」為兩圖上之。

translations.literal: ' He submitted both diagrams.
translations.idiomatic: " He submitted both diagrams.

sentences.zh: 又援《祭 法》，言：「翼祖、宣祖在二祧之位，猶同祖禰之廟，皆月祭之，與親廟一等，無親疏遠近之殺。

translations.literal: He also cited the Treatise on Sacrificial Rites, stating: "Ancestors Yi and Xuan occupy the two lineage-shrine positions, still like temples of grandfather and father; all receive monthly sacrifices, equal to close temples, without gradation of intimacy, distance, near, or far.
translations.idiomatic: He also cited the Treatise on Sacrificial Rites, arguing: "Ancestors Yi and Xuan occupy the two lineage-shrine positions, equivalent to temples of grandfather and father; all receive monthly sacrifices on equal footing with close temples, without gradation by intimacy or distance.

sentences.zh: 順祖實去祧之主，若有四時祈禱，猶當就壇受祭。

translations.literal: Ancestor Shun is in fact a lord removed to lineage status; if there are seasonal prayers, he ought still to receive sacrifice at the altar.
translations.idiomatic: Ancestor Shun has in fact been moved to lineage status; if seasonal prayers are offered, he should still receive sacrifice at the altar.

sentences.zh: 請自今二祧神 主，殺於親廟，四時之祭，享嘗乃止，不及大烝，不薦新物。

translations.literal: We request that from now on the spirit tablets of the two lineage shrines be reduced below close temples; seasonal sacrifices stop at the xiang and chang offerings, not reaching the great xia, and not presenting new produce.
translations.idiomatic: We request that henceforth the spirit tablets of the two lineage shrines rank below close temples: seasonal sacrifices should stop at the xiang and chang offerings, not extend to the great xia, and not include presentation of new produce.

sentences.zh: 去祧神主，有禱則為壇而祭，庶合典禮。

translations.literal: For spirit tablets removed to lineage status, when there are prayers, an altar is made for sacrifice—then it will broadly accord with canonical ritual.
translations.idiomatic: For ancestors moved to lineage status, prayers should be answered with altar sacrifices—this would broadly accord with canonical ritual.

sentences.zh: 」又請建新廟於始祖之西，略如古方明壇製。

translations.literal: " He also requested building a new temple west of the founding ancestor, roughly like the ancient square-bright altar design.
translations.idiomatic: " He also proposed building a new temple west of the founding ancestor, roughly following the ancient square-bright altar design.

sentences.zh: 有詔，俟廟製成 日取旨。

translations.literal: An edict was issued to await the day when the temple system was completed before taking imperial guidance.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that imperial guidance be taken once the temple system was completed.

sentences.zh: 三年，禮文所言：「古者宗廟為石室以藏主，謂之宗祏。

translations.literal: In the third year, the ritual texts stated: "In antiquity ancestral temples were stone chambers for storing tablets, called the ancestral tablet-shrine.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, the ritual texts stated: "In antiquity ancestral temples used stone chambers to store spirit tablets, called the ancestral tablet-shrine.

sentences.zh: 夫婦一體，同幾共牢。

translations.literal: Husband and wife are one body, sharing the same spirit-table and joint sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Husband and wife are one body, sharing the same spirit-table and joint sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 一室之中，有左主、右主之別，正廟之主，各藏廟室西壁之 中；

translations.literal: Within one chamber there is distinction between left tablet and right tablet; tablets of the main temple are each stored in the center of the western wall of the temple chamber;
translations.idiomatic: Within one chamber there is a left tablet and a right tablet; tablets of the main temple are each stored in the center of the chamber's western wall;

sentences.zh: 遷廟之主，藏於太祖太室北壁之中，其埳去地六尺一寸。

translations.literal: tablets of moved temples are stored in the center of the northern wall of the Great Ancestor's grand chamber; the niche is six feet one inch above the ground.
translations.idiomatic: tablets of moved temples are stored in the center of the northern wall of the Great Ancestor's grand chamber, in a niche six feet one inch above the ground.

sentences.zh: 今太廟藏主之室，帝後異處，遷主仍藏西夾室，求之於禮，有所未合。

translations.literal: Today the Grand Temple's chambers for storing tablets place emperor and empress in separate locations; moved tablets are still stored in the western collateral chamber—seeking this in ritual, something does not conform.
translations.idiomatic: Today the Grand Temple stores emperor and empress tablets separately, and moved tablets remain in the western collateral chamber—measured against ritual, this falls short of proper practice.

sentences.zh: 請新廟成，並遵古制。

translations.literal: We request that when the new temple is completed, all follow the ancient system.
translations.idiomatic: We request that when the new temple is completed, all arrangements follow the ancient system.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The court approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 二月，慈聖光獻皇后祔廟，前二日，告天地、社稷、太廟、皇后廟如故事。

translations.literal: In the second month, when Empress Cisheng Guangxian was enshrined collaterally in the temple, two days before, Heaven and Earth, the Altars of Soil and Grain, the Grand Temple, and the Empress's Temple were notified according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, as Empress Cisheng Guangxian was installed in the temple, Heaven and Earth, the Altars of Soil and Grain, the Grand Temple, and the Empress's Temple were notified two days beforehand according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 至日，奉神主先詣僖祖室，次翼祖室，次宣祖室，次太祖室，次太宗室。

translations.literal: On the day, the spirit tablets were brought first to the chamber of Ancestor Xi, then Ancestor Yi, then Ancestor Xuan, then Taizu, then Taizong.
translations.idiomatic: On the appointed day, the spirit tablets were brought first to Ancestor Xi's chamber, then Ancestor Yi's, Ancestor Xuan's, Taizu's, and Taizong's.

sentences.zh: 次太宗與懿德皇 後、明德皇后同一祝，次享元德皇后。

translations.literal: Next Taizong shared one prayer text with Empresses Yide and Mingde; next the Yuande Empress was honored.
translations.idiomatic: Next Taizong shared one prayer text with Empresses Yide and Mingde; then the Yuande Empress was honored.

sentences.zh: 慈聖光獻皇后，異饌位、異祝，行祔謁禮。

translations.literal: Empress Cisheng Guangxian had a separate offering station and separate prayer text, performing the collateral enshrinement audience rite.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Cisheng Guangxian received a separate offering station and prayer text, performing the collateral enshrinement audience rite.

sentences.zh: 次真宗室，次仁宗室，次英宗室。

translations.literal: Next the chamber of Zhenzong, then Renzong, then Yingzong.
translations.idiomatic: Next came Zhenzong's chamber, then Renzong's, then Yingzong's.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，奉神主歸仁宗室。

translations.literal: When the rites were completed, the spirit tablets were brought back to Renzong's chamber.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites were completed, the spirit tablets were returned to Renzong's chamber.

sentences.zh: 元豐六年 六月，孝惠、孝章、淑德、章懷四後升祔，準章獻明肅、章懿二後，升祔禮畢，遞享太廟，止行升祔享禮及祭七祀，權罷孟冬薦享，仍以配繼先後為序。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the sixth year of Yuanfeng, the four empresses Xiaohui, Xiaozhang, Shude, and Zhanghuai were elevated and enshrined collaterally; following the two empresses Zhangxian Mingsu and Zhangyi, when the elevation and collateral enshrinement rites were completed, sacrifices were offered in succession at the Grand Temple—only the elevation-collateral enshrinement offering and sacrifice to the seven household spirits were performed; the mid-winter recommended offering was provisionally suspended; sequence still followed the order of consorts and successors.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of 1083, Empresses Xiaohui, Xiaozhang, Shude, and Zhanghuai were elevated and installed collaterally; following the precedent of Empresses Zhangxian Mingsu and Zhangyi, after the installation rites the court offered sacrifices in succession at the Grand Temple—performing only the elevation and collateral installation offerings and sacrifices to the seven household spirits, provisionally suspending the mid-winter recommended offering, with sequence still determined by the order of consorts and successors.

sentences.zh: 八年，禮部 太常寺言：「詔書定七世八室之制。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, the Ministry of Rites and Court of Imperial Sacrifices stated: "The edict fixed the system of seven generations and eight chambers.
translations.idiomatic: In 1085, the Ministry of Rites and Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: "The edict had fixed the system of seven generations and eight chambers.

sentences.zh: 今神宗皇帝崇祔，翼祖在七世之外，與簡穆皇后祧藏於西夾室，置石室中。

translations.literal: Now that Emperor Shenzong is to be honored with collateral enshrinement, Ancestor Yi lies beyond the seven generations and, with Empress Jianmu, is stored in lineage status in the western collateral chamber, placed in a stone chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Now that Emperor Shenzong is to be honored with collateral installation, Ancestor Yi lies beyond the seven generations and, together with Empress Jianmu, is stored in lineage status in the western collateral chamber within a stone compartment.

sentences.zh: 」十一月丁酉，祔神宗神主於第八室。

translations.literal: " On the day dingyou of the eleventh month, Shenzong's spirit tablet was enshrined collaterally in the eighth chamber.
translations.idiomatic: " On dingyou, the eleventh month, Shenzong's spirit tablet was installed in the eighth chamber.

sentences.zh: 自英宗上至宣 祖以次升遷。

translations.literal: From Yingzong upward to Ancestor Xuan, each was moved upward in succession.
translations.idiomatic: From Yingzong upward through Ancestor Xuan, each ancestor was shifted upward in succession.

sentences.zh: 紹聖元年二月，祔宣仁聖烈皇后於太廟。

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Shaosheng, Empress Xuanren Shengle was enshrined collaterally in the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of 1094, Empress Xuanren Shengle was installed collaterally in the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 元符三年，禮部太常寺言：「哲宗升祔，宜如晉成帝故事，於太廟殿增一室，候祔廟日，神主祔 第九室。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yuanfu, the Ministry of Rites and Court of Imperial Sacrifices stated: "When Zhezong is elevated and enshrined collaterally, it should follow the precedent of Jin's Emperor Chengdi, adding one chamber to the Grand Temple hall; when the day of collateral enshrinement arrives, the spirit tablet is enshrined in the ninth chamber.
translations.idiomatic: In 1100, the Ministry of Rites and Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: "When Zhezong is elevated and installed collaterally, the court should follow the precedent of Jin's Emperor Chengdi by adding one chamber to the Grand Temple hall and installing his spirit tablet in the ninth chamber on the day of installation.

sentences.zh: 」詔下侍從官議，皆如所言。

translations.literal: " An edict was issued for deliberation by attendant officials; all agreed with what was stated.
translations.idiomatic: " The court referred the matter to attendant officials for deliberation; all agreed with the proposal.

sentences.zh: 蔡京議：「以哲宗嗣神宗大統，父子相承，自當為世。

translations.literal: Cai Jing deliberated: "Since Zhezong succeeded Shenzong's great succession, father and son succeeding one another, they naturally constitute one generation.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Jing argued: "Since Zhezong succeeded Shenzong's great succession, father and son succeeding one another naturally constitute one generation.

sentences.zh: 今若不祧遠祖，不以哲宗為世，則三昭四穆與太祖之廟而八。

translations.literal: If now the distant ancestor is not moved to lineage status and Zhezong is not counted as a generation, then three Zhao, four Mu, and the temple of the Great Ancestor make eight.
translations.idiomatic: If the distant ancestor is not moved to lineage status and Zhezong is not counted as a separate generation, the temple would hold three Zhao, four Mu, and the Great Ancestor—eight in all.

sentences.zh: 宜深考載 籍，遷祔如禮。

translations.literal: It is fitting to examine deeply the records and histories and move and enshrine collaterally according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: The court should examine the records thoroughly and carry out the transfer and installation according to ritual.

sentences.zh: 」陸佃、曾肇等議：「國朝自僖祖而下始備七廟，故英宗祔廟，則遷順祖，神宗祔廟，則遷翼祖。

translations.literal: " Lu Dian, Zeng Zhao, and others deliberated: "Our dynasty from Ancestor Xi downward first completed seven temples; therefore when Yingzong was enshrined collaterally, Ancestor Shun was moved; when Shenzong was enshrined collaterally, Ancestor Yi was moved.
translations.idiomatic: " Lu Dian, Zeng Zhao, and others argued: "Our dynasty first completed seven temples from Ancestor Xi downward; when Yingzong was installed, Ancestor Shun was moved; when Shenzong was installed, Ancestor Yi was moved.

sentences.zh: 今哲宗於神宗，父子也，如禮官議，則廟中當有八 世。

translations.literal: Now Zhezong and Shenzong are father and son; as the ritual officials deliberate, the temple ought to have eight generations.
translations.idiomatic: Zhezong and Shenzong are father and son; as the ritual officials propose, the temple would then hold eight generations.

sentences.zh: 況唐文宗即位則遷肅宗，以敬宗為一世，故事不遠。

translations.literal: Moreover, when Tang's Wenzong took the throne, Suzong was moved and Jingzong was treated as one generation—the precedent is not distant.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, when Tang's Wenzong took the throne, Suzong was moved and Jingzong treated as one generation—a precedent not far removed.

sentences.zh: 哲宗祔廟，當以神宗為昭，上遷宣祖，以合古三昭三穆之義。

translations.literal: When Zhezong is enshrined collaterally in the temple, Shenzong ought to be made Zhao, and Ancestor Xuan moved upward, to accord with the ancient meaning of three Zhao and three Mu.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhezong is installed, Shenzong should occupy the Zhao position and Ancestor Xuan moved upward, in accord with the ancient principle of three Zhao and three Mu.

sentences.zh: 」先是，李清臣為禮部尚書，首建增室之議， 侍郎趙挺之等和之。

translations.literal: " Earlier, Li Qingchen as Minister of Rites first proposed adding a chamber; Vice Minister Zhao Tingzhi and others joined him.
translations.idiomatic: " Earlier, Li Qingchen as Minister of Rites had first proposed adding a chamber, joined by Vice Minister Zhao Tingzhi and others.

sentences.zh: 會清臣為門下侍郎，論者多從其議，惟京、佃等議異。

translations.literal: When Qingchen became Vice Director of the Secretariat, most debaters followed his deliberation; only Jing, Dian, and others differed.
translations.idiomatic: By the time Qingchen became Vice Director of the Secretariat, most debaters followed his view; only Cai Jing, Lu Dian, and others dissented.

sentences.zh: 二議既上，清臣辯說甚力，帝迄從焉。

translations.literal: When both deliberations were submitted, Qingchen argued forcefully, and the emperor ultimately followed him.
translations.idiomatic: When both proposals were submitted, Qingchen argued forcefully, and the emperor ultimately followed his view.

sentences.zh: 六月，禮部請用太廟東夾室奉安哲宗 神主。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the Ministry of Rites requested using the Grand Temple's eastern collateral chamber to install Zhezong's spirit tablet.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the Ministry of Rites proposed installing Zhezong's spirit tablet in the Grand Temple's eastern collateral chamber.

sentences.zh: 太常少卿孫傑言：「先帝神主，錯之夾室，即是不得祔於正廟，與前詔增建一室之議不同。

translations.literal: Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Sun Jie stated: "The late emperor's spirit tablet, placed wrongly in a collateral chamber, means he cannot be enshrined collaterally in the main temple—this differs from the prior edict's deliberation to add and build one chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Director Sun Jie of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices objected: "Placing the late emperor's spirit tablet in a collateral chamber means he cannot be installed in the main temple—this contradicts the prior edict's proposal to add a chamber.

sentences.zh: 昨用嘉祐故事，專置使修奉，請以夾室奉安神主，亦與元置使之意 相違。

translations.literal: Yesterday the Jiayou precedent was used and a commissioner was specially appointed for maintenance; requesting installation of the spirit tablet in a collateral chamber also contradicts the original intent in appointing the commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The court had followed the Jiayou precedent by appointing a special commissioner for maintenance; installing the tablet in a collateral chamber also contradicts the original purpose of that appointment.

sentences.zh: 請如太常前議，增建一室。

translations.literal: We request following the Court of Imperial Sacrifices' prior deliberation and adding one chamber.
translations.idiomatic: We request following the Court of Imperial Sacrifices' prior proposal and adding one chamber.

sentences.zh: 」尚書省以廟室未備，行禮有期，權宜升祔，隨即增修，比之前代設幄行事者，不為不至。

translations.literal: " The Department of State Affairs, because temple chambers were not ready and the rites had a fixed date, provisionally elevated and enshrined collaterally for the moment and then added repairs—compared with former ages setting up tents to perform the rites, this was not insufficient.
translations.idiomatic: " The Department of State Affairs argued that because the temple chambers were not ready and the rites had a fixed date, a provisional elevation and installation followed by immediate repairs was no less thorough than former dynasties' practice of erecting tents to perform the rites.

sentences.zh: 詔依初旨行之，乃祔哲宗神主於夾室。

translations.literal: An edict ordered following the initial intent; thereupon Zhezong's spirit tablet was enshrined collaterally in a collateral chamber.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered following the initial intent, and Zhezong's spirit tablet was installed in a collateral chamber.

sentences.zh: 崇寧二年，祧宣祖與昭憲皇后神主藏西夾室，居翼祖、簡穆皇后石室之次。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chongning, the spirit tablets of Ancestor Xuan and Empress Zhaoxian were moved to lineage storage in the western collateral chamber, placed next to the stone chamber of Ancestor Yi and Empress Jianmu.
translations.idiomatic: In 1103, the spirit tablets of Ancestor Xuan and Empress Zhaoxian were moved to lineage storage in the western collateral chamber, placed next to the stone compartment of Ancestor Yi and Empress Jianmu.

sentences.zh: 五年，詔曰：「去古既遠，諸儒之說不同。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, an edict stated: "Having departed from antiquity for long, the explanations of the various Ru differ.
translations.idiomatic: In 1106, an edict stated: "Having departed from antiquity for so long, the various Ru scholars' explanations differ.

sentences.zh: 鄭氏謂：『太祖及文、武不祧之廟與親廟 四，為七。

translations.literal: Master Zheng said: 'The temples of the Great Ancestor and Wen and Wu that are never moved to lineage status, together with four close temples, make seven.'
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Xuan held: "The temples of the Great Ancestor and Kings Wen and Wu that are never displaced, together with four close temples, make seven."

sentences.zh: 』是不祧之宗，在七廟之內。

translations.literal: ' Thus the lineage never moved is within the seven temples.
translations.idiomatic: " Thus the immovable lineage falls within the seven temples.

sentences.zh: 王氏謂：『非太祖而不毀，不為常數。

translations.literal: Master Wang said: 'What is not destroyed unless it is not the Great Ancestor is not a constant rule.'
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi held: "Only the Great Ancestor's temple is never destroyed—this is not a fixed rule for all."

sentences.zh: 』是不祧之宗，在七廟之外。

translations.literal: ' Thus the lineage never moved is outside the seven temples.
translations.idiomatic: " Thus the immovable lineage stands outside the seven temples.

sentences.zh: 本朝今已五宗，則七廟當祧者，二宗而已。

translations.literal: Our dynasty now already has five zong; then of the seven temples, only two zong ought to be moved to lineage status.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty now has five immovable zong; of the seven temples, only two should be moved to lineage status.

sentences.zh: 遷毀之禮， 近及祖考，殆非先王尊祖之意，宜令有司復議。

translations.literal: The rites of moving and destroying temples, reaching nearly to grandfather and father, perhaps do not accord with the former kings' intent to honor ancestors—the responsible officials should deliberate again.
translations.idiomatic: The rites of moving and destroying temples now reach nearly to grandfather and father—hardly in accord with the former kings' intent to honor ancestors. The responsible officials should deliberate again.

sentences.zh: 」禮官言：「先王之制，廟止於七，後王以義起禮，乃有增置九廟者。

translations.literal: " The ritual officials stated: "The former kings' system fixed temples at seven; later kings, arising ritual by principle, then had cases of adding nine temples.
translations.idiomatic: " The ritual officials replied: "The former kings limited temples to seven; later rulers, arising ritual from principle, sometimes added nine.

sentences.zh: 」禮部尚書徐鐸又言：「唐之獻祖、中宗、代 宗與本朝僖祖，皆嘗祧而復。

translations.literal: " Minister of Rites Xu Duo also stated: "Tang's Ancestor Xian, Zhongzong, and Daizong, and our dynasty's Ancestor Xi, were all once moved to lineage status and then restored.
translations.idiomatic: " Minister of Rites Xu Duo added: "Tang's Ancestor Xian, Zhongzong, and Daizong, and our dynasty's Ancestor Xi, were all once moved to lineage status and then restored.

sentences.zh: 今存宣祖於當祧之際，復翼祖於已祧之後，以備九廟，禮無不稱。

translations.literal: Now preserving Ancestor Xuan at the moment when he ought to be moved to lineage status, and restoring Ancestor Yi after he had been moved, to complete nine temples—ritual has nothing that does not fit.
translations.idiomatic: Preserving Ancestor Xuan when he would normally be moved to lineage status and restoring Ancestor Yi after his removal, to complete nine temples—nothing in ritual would be unfitting.

sentences.zh: 」乃命鐸為修奉使，增太廟殿為十室。

translations.literal: " Thereupon Duo was appointed maintenance commissioner, and the Grand Temple hall was increased to ten chambers.
translations.idiomatic: " Xu Duo was appointed maintenance commissioner, and the Grand Temple hall was expanded to ten chambers.

sentences.zh: 四年十二月，復翼祖、宣祖 廟，行奉安禮，惟不用前期誓戒及亞、終獻之樂舞焉。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the fourth year, the temples of Ancestors Yi and Xuan were restored and the installation rite performed—only without the prior oath of abstinence and the music and dance of the secondary and final offerings.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the fourth year, the temples of Ancestors Yi and Xuan were restored and the installation rite performed—without, however, the prior oath of abstinence or the music and dance of the secondary and final offerings.

sentences.zh: 高宗建炎二年，奉太廟神主於揚州壽寧寺。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jianyan, Gaozong brought the Grand Temple spirit tablets to Shouning Temple in Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In 1128, Gaozong brought the Grand Temple spirit tablets to Shouning Temple in Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 三年，幸杭州，奉安於溫州。

translations.literal: In the third year, when the emperor visited Hangzhou, they were installed in Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In 1129, when the court moved to Hangzhou, the tablets were installed in Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 紹興五年，司封郎中林待聘言：「太廟神主宜在國都。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Shaoxing, Director of the Bureau of Enfeoffment Lin Daipin stated: "The Grand Temple spirit tablets ought to be in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In 1135, Director Lin Daipin of the Bureau of Enfeoffment argued: "The Grand Temple spirit tablets ought to reside in the capital.

sentences.zh: 今新邑未奠，當如古行師載主之義，遷之行闕，以彰聖孝。

translations.literal: Now the new capital is not yet settled; it should be as in antiquity when armies on campaign carried the tablets—move them to the traveling palace to display sagely filial piety.
translations.idiomatic: Since the new capital is not yet settled, the court should follow antiquity's practice of carrying spirit tablets on campaign—moving them to the traveling palace to display sagely filial devotion.

sentences.zh: 」於是始建太廟於臨安，奉迎安置。

translations.literal: " Thereupon the Grand Temple was first built in Lin'an, and the tablets were brought and installed.
translations.idiomatic: " The Grand Temple was then first built in Lin'an, and the spirit tablets were brought and installed.
